description: European Instrument for International Nuclear Safety Cooperation (INSC) Annual Action Plan 2026 Annex – Component A4: Türkiye – Service contract. The capacities of the Turkish nuclear regulatory authority (NDK) and its Technical Support Organization (NÜTED) are being developed in parallel with the construction of the Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant. An ongoing INSC intervention (ending end of April 2027) is supporting regulatory framework consolidation and alignment with EU and international standards. Further support is needed to complement or follow-up the results achieved so far, in particular in regulatory areas such as nuclear safety, radiation safety and radiation protection, safe radioactive waste management, radioactive transport safety, inspection as well as the interface between safety and security.

description: Under the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA, Regulation 2023/1114) the European Banking Authority (EBA) is entrusted with direct supervisory responsibilities , where an asset-referenced token (ART) or electronic money token (EMT) is determined to be significant. To conduct the significance assessment, the EBA will use (i) regulatory reporting data and (ii) market monitoring, including crypto-asset data obtained via external data providers. Furthermore, the EBA has a statutory duty to monitor and assess market developments, including technological innovation and innovative financial services. In this regard, the EBA aims to obtain data to monitor and analyse crypto-asset market developments, including activities outside the current scope of MiCA, such as Decentralised Finance (DeFi) and activities involving tokenised assets. The EBA seeks to collect granular (and aggregate, where appropriate) real or near real-time data on crypto-assets and crypto-assets markets, including: 1) on-chain network data (e.g., the transaction, operational and economic activity occurring on a blockchain network, etc.), and 2) off-chain market data (e.g., the crypto-asset prices/quotes, market capitalisation, volumes, trade/order book data and trading venue-related information, etc.), relating to different blockchain networks and trading venues to monitor crypto assets in the EU and globally. Data should be accessible via a commercial subscription model. The services would also be provided for the Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AMLA).

To conduct the significance assessment, the EBA will use (i) regulatory reporting data and (ii) market monitoring, including crypto-asset data obtained via external data providers. 

Furthermore, the EBA has a statutory duty to monitor and assess market developments, including technological innovation and innovative financial services. In this regard, the EBA aims to obtain data to monitor and analyse crypto-asset market developments, including activities outside the current scope of MiCA, such as Decentralised Finance (DeFi) and activities involving tokenised assets.

The EBA seeks to collect granular (and aggregate, where appropriate) real or near real-time data on crypto-assets and crypto-assets markets, including:
1) on-chain network data (e.g., the transaction, operational and economic activity occurring on a blockchain network, etc.), and
2) off-chain market data (e.g., the crypto-asset prices/quotes, market capitalisation, volumes, trade/order book data and trading venue-related information, etc.),
relating to different blockchain networks and trading venues to monitor crypto assets in the EU and globally. Data should be accessible via a commercial subscription model. The services would also be provided for the Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AMLA).

description: The work under the contract "Support to Eurostat in the domain of Purchasing Power Parities (PPP) for the implementation of the 2027 equipment goods price survey" aims to support Eurostat in the coordination of the PPP surveys on equipment goods and derive PPPs for the component of gross fixed capital formation. This work covers the 41 countries participating in the European Comparison Programme (ECP): EU Member States, EFTA/EEA countries, enlargement countries and the UK. The policy relevance and use of PPPs lie in their role in converting national accounts aggregates into comparable volume measures and in analysing relative price levels across EU countries. This requires high-quality PPP data. These requirements put very strong emphasis on the collection of comparable price data across countries, the validation of the data, and the methodology applied for calculating the PPPs. All according to detailed and agreed time-schedules for the releases of the PPPs. The work on equipment goods prices requires technical knowledge of machinery, electronic and other equipment that is not available at Eurostat. It is, therefore, necessary to ensure high quality standards for the implementation of the contract.

description:
Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist der Einkauf von Serienmobiliar (System- und sonstiges Serienmobiliar) 
sowie Arbeitsplatzstühlen und Beleuchtung, hauptsächlich für den Ersatz von Bestandsmobiliar sowie die 
Erstausstattung von Gebäudebereichen aufgrund von Nutzungsänderungen im Hauptquartier der EASA am 
Standort Köln, und für die Ergänzungsausstattung des Kontaktbüros der EASA in Brüssel.  
Folgende Leistungen sind zu erbringen: Lieferung, funktionsfertige Montage und Aufstellen der 
beschriebenen Produkte am Verwendungsort einschließlich Abladen, ggf. Lagern auf der Verwendungsstelle, 
Entsorgung von anfallenden Abfällen, gegebenenfalls Wartung und Reparaturen.

description:
Le présent avis est destiné à informer les acteurs du marché immobilier, ainsi que toute autre partie intéressée, sur les prévisions des besoins immobiliers du Parlement européen à Bruxelles et à recueillir les noms des opérateurs susceptibles d’être intéressés par la procédure de prospection immobilière. 
Le Parlement européen pourra ensuite recourir à une/des procédure(s) négociée(s) sans publication préalable d’un avis de marché, conformément aux dispositions du Règlement 2018/1046.

description: The objective of this framework contract is to operate the CEMS "Hydrological Forecast Centre - Computation" (COMP) service in support to the flood early warning and monitoring component of the Copernicus Emergency Management Service (CEMS) which continues as full operational service as defined in article 51(1.b)) of the regulation (EU) 2021/696 of the Union Space Program. The role of COMP is to execute the flood forecasts for EFAS and GloFAS and hosts the different data dissemination and visualization platforms. The framework contract is a follow up of an existing framework contract 941462-IPR-2021. The CEMS implementation is an inter-service arrangement between DG JRC, DG DEFIS and DG ECHO (Ares (2021) 2234141). The JRC is in charge of preparing and implements the CEMS work programmes, manages dedicated budgets and supervises the implementation of service tasks.

description: The aim of the contract is to understand how EU farms may transform over the next 10 to 30 years during the “AI revolution,” with the goal of identifying how AI-driven farms may operate and the potential structural transformations and disruptions in EU agriculture. To achieve this, the study will develop an analytical framework combining farm typologies, AI scenarios, and focus questions to assess how different types of farms may evolve under alternative AI pathways. Representative farm typologies will reflect the diversity of EU farming systems in terms of production orientation, land use, size, labour structure, and resource allocation, while AI scenarios will outline possible technological developments over the next 10–30 years based on literature and expert knowledge. The study will analyse how farms may adapt their management and organisation under each scenario and identify potential transformations and disruptions at the farm level, including changes in land, labour, capital, assets, data, and market integration. The analysis will rely primarily on qualitative methods, drawing on literature and expert input through interviews, focus groups, workshops, and desk research, with validation by stakeholders and domain experts.

description: The European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA) is planning to launch a call for tender for the provision of research services. The subject of this call for tenders is “Overview of climate change-related risks and their implications for occupational safety and health” (3 Lots). The contracting authority is carrying out a major research activity focusing on climate change and OSH during the period 2026-2028. The work includes investigating climate change-related risks, their impacts on workers’ health and measures to prevent or manage these risks. The activity takes a holistic approach to the consideration of the impact of climate change on OSH, exploring how different climate drivers intersect to generate or amplify a wide range of occupational risks. It builds upon previous work by the contracting authority on the topic, such as the foresight study on OSH in green jobs, the foresight study on the circular economy and its effects on OSH, the guidance for workplaces on heat at work, and the findings from the ‘OSH Pulse 2025’ survey on OSH in the era of climate and digital change. In this context, this call for tenders invites bids for the provision of services aimed at collecting information and developing knowledge on the following subjects: 1 Climate change, psychosocial risks and mental health 2 Overview of policy and regulation on climate change and OSH in the European Union 3 Facts and figures on climate change and OSH: statistical evidence and measurement challenges. Expected deliverables are research reports, case study reports, policy briefs and presentations. The maximum total budget available for the contract to be awarded is EUR 139,990 (excluding VAT). Lot 1: EUR 49,995 Lot 2: EUR 40,000 Lot 3: EUR 49,995 It is possible to express interest as an individual organisation or a consortium. However please note that invited candidates can submit a joint tender with other economic operators only if they have expressed interest in the planned procedure as a consortium. More information regarding the participation rules can be found in the link "More information can be found here".

description: The Statistical Office of Montenegro (MONSTAT) needs to implement a digital transformation of the IT system with the scope to make more data available for tackling societal, climate and environment-related challenges, contributing to healthier, more prosperous and more sustainable society. This goal will be reached by implementing two activities: 1) enabling technical services for the exchange and usage of data needed for the production of official statistics, owned by private and public sector and 2) modernizing the technology for data collection, processing and dissemination. The action is based on the priorities outlined in the Development Strategy of Official Statistics 2024-2028 and incorporate lessons from recent user satisfaction survey that note the need for using the potentials of new technologies for statistical purposes. MONSTAT will need to be active in developing new methods for data collection and creating new services related to data delivery for society. Considering the above, the upgrade and improvement of the collection methods and processes in official statistics, especially the delivery and dissemination of MONSTAT services, should be at the highest possible level.

description: The European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU OSHA) is planning to launch a call for tender for the provision of expert services to support an analytical project on work-related accidents in the EU: facts and figures. The objective of the contract is to deliver a concise, evidence-based overview of work-related accidents and injuries in the EU, including trends, causes, impacts and prevention approaches. The contractor will analyse and synthesise existing statistical and research evidence, including EU-level datasets (e.g. Eurostat), national data sources and scientific literature, explore new models of data gathering, and assess key challenges such as underreporting, high-risk groups and emerging risks. The results of the contract will support EU OSHA in: • strengthening the evidence base for accident prevention, • informing policy development and strategic priorities, • preparing future analytical work and awareness-raising activities. Expected deliverables are: an inception report detailing the refined methodology and work plan, an Interim progress update, a draft and final analytical report presenting findings, limitations, conclusions and priorities for further work, a concise executive summary suitable for non technical audiences, a presentation (PowerPoint or equivalent) summarising key results and policy relevant messages, and a Policy brief identifying key actions and main priority areas. The maximum total budget available for the contract is EUR 139,000 (excluding VAT). It is possible to express interest as an individual organisation or a consortium. However please note that invited candidates can submit a joint tender with other economic operators only if they have expressed interest in the planned procedure as a consortium. More information regarding the participation rules: https://ec.europa.eu/docsroom/documents/65114 Please find the technical and professional capacity required for this contract here: https://osha.europa.eu/en/about-eu-osha/procurement/call-tender/osha2026mvp0016-exa-work-related-accidents-eu-osh-figures-analysis-trends-causes-and-prevention

description: The subject of this call for tenders is the service portfolio related to the European Commission’s Digital Workplace (DWP) and its customers and users, ensuring the provision of efficient, end-user experience driven, proactive and resilient solutions and support services. The procedure aims to ensure the operational continuity while driving progress through the adoption of latest technologies aligning to the evolving business objectives of the European Commission, targeting the services falling within the scope of the current framework contract DI-07810, awarded under Lot 1 of the open call for tenders DIGIT/A3/PO/2018/015 EUSS-SM and expiring in June 2027. The service portfolio covers Digital Workplace support services, device lifecycle management, endpoint management and technical (backend) services ranging from support activities and operations to related engineering activities. The procedure will contain one lot to ensure full end-to-end delivery and maximized quality of service in a modern managed services approach.

description: The subject of this call for tenders is the service portfolio related to the European Commission’s Digital Workplace (DWP) and its customers and users, ensuring the provision of efficient, end-user experience driven, proactive and resilient solutions and support services. The procedure aims to ensure the operational continuity while driving progress through the adoption of latest technologies aligning to the evolving business objectives of the European Commission, targeting the services falling within the scope of the current framework contract DI-07810, awarded under Lot 1 of the open call for tenders DIGIT/A3/PO/2018/015 EUSS-SM and expiring in June 2027. The service portfolio covers Digital Workplace support services, device lifecycle management, endpoint management and technical (backend) services ranging from support activities and operations to related engineering activities. The procedure will contain one lot to ensure full end-to-end delivery and maximized quality of service in a modern managed services approach.

description: The Directorate-General for Digital Services (DIGIT) intends to launch an open procedure under the name of EXPRESS. The procedure will cover the service portfolio related to the European Commission’s Digital Workplace (DWP) and its customers/users ensuring the provision of efficient, end-user experience driven, proactive and resilient solutions and support services. The procedure aims to ensure the operational continuity while driving progress through the adoption of latest technologies aligning to the evolving business objectives of the European Commission, targeting the services falling within the scope of the current framework contract DI¬07810, awarded under Lot 1 of the open call for tenders DIGIT/A3/PO/2018/015 EUSS-SM and expiring in June 2027. The service portfolio covers Digital Workplace support services, device lifecycle management, endpoint management and technical (backend) services ranging from support activities and operations to related engineering activities. The procedure will contain one lot to ensure full end-to-end delivery and maximized quality of service in a modern managed services approach. It will result in the signature of a single framework contract (no cascade and reopening of competition). The maximum duration of 84 months is split in a core duration of 48 months, renewable three times for 12 months.

description: The proposal is to organise the ERCEA Staff End-of-Year event on 17 December 2026, from 6pm to 12pm. The programme will include food, drinks, live music, a performance, brief speeches, and dancing. The event targets all ERCEA staff, with the participation of the President of the ERC. The aim of the festive gathering will be to thank the staff for its hard work and reinforce the links and synergies between Units and Departments of the ERCEA. The purpose of this call for tender is to secure the rental of the venue and the catering services for the event.

description: EUAA envisages awarding up to three (3) framework service contracts in cascade for each Lot for the provision of high-quality Event Organisation Services and related travel and logistical services required for the organisation and implementation of the Agency's administrative and operational meetings and events. The framework contracts will support events organised in Moldova (Lot 1), Ukraine (Lot 2) and the Western Balkans (Lot 3), as further described in the Technical specifications. The services to be provided under the framework contracts will depend on the specific requirements of each event, as defined by the Agency. They may include, but are not limited to: • Conference venue rental; • Provision of audio-visual (AV) and interpretation equipment; • Catering services; • Coordination of third-party service providers and on-site logistical management; • Preparation of event signage and submission of supporting documents and invoices, where required; • Rental of AV and interpretation equipment for venues provided by the Agency, stakeholders or other third parties; • Organisation of lunches, dinners and other catering arrangements; • Reservation of suitable accommodation in accordance with the Agency's requirements; • Organisation, provision and supervision of transportation services; • Provision of event assistance services before, during and after the event; • Coordination and provision of security and medical services, where required; • Processing and payment of travel, accommodation and/or subsistence allowances for event participants, including the collection of the relevant supporting documents, in accordance with the Agency's instructions. Events in Ukraine will only be organised where the prevailing security situation allows the Agency to hold in-person events, following the Agency's security assessment and any applicable security restrictions.

description: Western Balkans countries are affected at varying levels by radioactive waste generated by past activities and current medical, industrial and research applications and legacy radioactive lightning rods. Recent interventions in Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina, respectively, addressed the partial decommissioning of legacy facilities at the Vinça site and the start of the selection and licensing of a centralised radioactive waste storage facility for the safe management of disused sealed radiation sources in Bosnia-Herzegovina. Continuing support to the countries in the Western Balkans is necessary in order to sustainably improve their radioactive waste management.

description: The scope of work is summarized as bellow: a) Construction of approximately 3.039 km wastewater collector pipeline, including ground improvement works, b) Construction of approximately 30 m Special Crossing of river by pipejacking and/or horizontal drilling wastewater collector pipeline, c) Construction of 3 prefabricated GRP (Glass Reinforced Plastic) Package Type Wastewater Pumping Station (Bağdatlı, Çiftekavak and Hal) d) Approximately 12 m forced mains and associated structures, e) Construction of approximately 87 manholes, including relevant ground improvement works f) Installation of complementary SCADA System which is composed of operator workstation system, SCADA software and licences, other relevant software and licences, and system accessories g) Preparation of wastewater collection system network as-built plans for constructed sewer mains, h) Complementary works and documentation, including: 1. CCTV inspection for approximately 6,920 m installed pipes, 2. Leakage test for approximately 963 m installed pipes, 3. Leakage test for approximately 44 manholes, 4. Completion of non-completed bridge crossing works, 5. Correction of non-conformities, 6. Provision of Certificate of Origin in accordance with Sub-Clause 7.9, 7. Preparation and submission of as-built plans for completed works. The design for the wastewater collection system involves, in most cases, the complete replacement of the existing pipelines. As these existing pipelines are “live” the Contractor shall need to carefully plan the works to maintain wastewater collection services to customers as much as possible. This issue shall be valid for all “live” wastewater pumping stations. During this planning, the service continuity should be in the first priority. System temporary rearrangements to be done for service continuity shall be taking into consideration during pricing. In wastewater collection system, package wastewater pumping station shall be supplied and installed during the construction of new one. These facilities shall be in operation until the final acceptance.

description:
The scope of work is summarized as bellow:
a) Construction of approximately 3.039 km wastewater collector pipeline, including ground
improvement works,
b) Construction of approximately 30 m Special Crossing of river by pipejacking and/or
horizontal drilling wastewater collector pipeline,
c) Construction of 3 prefabricated GRP (Glass Reinforced Plastic) Package Type
Wastewater Pumping Station (Bağdatlı, Çiftekavak and Hal)
d) Approximately 12 m forced mains and associated structures,
e) Construction of approximately 87 manholes, including relevant ground improvement
works
f) Installation of complementary SCADA System which is composed of operator
workstation system, SCADA software and licences, other relevant software and licences,
and system accessories
g) Preparation of wastewater collection system network as-built plans for constructed sewer
mains,
h) Complementary works and documentation, including:
1. CCTV inspection for approximately 6,920 m installed pipes,
2. Leakage test for approximately 963 m installed pipes,
3. Leakage test for approximately 44 manholes,
4. Completion of non-completed bridge crossing works,
5. Correction of non-conformities,
6. Provision of Certificate of Origin in accordance with Sub-Clause 7.9,
7. Preparation and submission of as-built plans for completed works.
The design for the wastewater collection system involves, in most cases, the complete
replacement of the existing pipelines. As these existing pipelines are “live” the Contractor shall
need to carefully plan the works to maintain wastewater collection services to customers as much
as possible. This issue shall be valid for all “live” wastewater pumping stations. During this
planning, the service continuity should be in the first priority. System temporary rearrangements
to be done for service continuity shall be taking into consideration during pricing. In wastewater
collection system, package wastewater pumping station shall be supplied and installed during the
construction of new one. These facilities shall be in operation until the final acceptance.

description: Organizing Europe Day concert in Narva, 9 May 2026 The EC Rep in Tallinn celebrates Europe Day in two cities in Estonia – Narva and Tallinn. Narva is the border city adjacent to Russia, located in the Ida-Viru county – the just transition area in Estonia, with a mainly Russian-speaking population who still celebrate 9 May as Soviet/Russian victory day. To shift this narrative, the EC Representation, in cooperation with partners (such as the Government Office, the Ministry of Culture, the Integration Foundation, the Europe Direct Center in Narva, Narva Museum, the University of Tartu’s Narva College, and other local institutions), has for the past two years provided a solid and credible alternative: a big public concert on 9 May with A-list performers specially loved by local people in Ida-Viru region. The aim is to strengthen the narrative of peace over victory by placing European values and voices at the heart of the 9 May public sphere. The concert (and its’ side events) has been a huge success with at least the same amount of people attending the Europe Day celebrations than those visiting the propaganda events on the other side of the river banks in Narva. Therefore, it is of utmost importance to continue with the started tradition and consolidate even further the understanding of Europe Day and the celebration of peace in Narva. Europe Day celebrations help to deliver our common European message: Europe starts in Narva, and Europe Day belongs to all of us, regardless of background. As such, in order to celebrate Europe Day on 9 May 2025, the EC Rep in Estonia is planning to organize a public concert in Narva, Estonia.

description: To further assist in the reduction of border obstacles and to enhance the synergy between b-solutions and territorial cooperation, the European Commission launches a call for tenders to set up a peer-to-peer exchange programme that would allow Interreg programmes to benefit from the experience of implemented b-solutions cases. The objective of the peer-to-peer exchange (henceforth the exchange) is for Interreg programmes to participate in visits to b-solutions cases. The exchange should include 10 visits, each organised by separate b-solutions case host organisations. Each visit should include 5 supported visitors from Interreg programmes up to a maximum of 50 supported visitors in total. Non-supported visitors from Interreg programmes would also be allowed to participate in the visits. Programmes that face similar challenges would visit a b-solutions case on the same topic. Both the visiting programmes and the host would benefit from sharing with peers from other territories that share similar challenges.

description: JRC Petten streeft ernaar een raamcontract af te sluiten voor de levering van onderhoud, reparatie, dagelijkse technische ondersteuning en kleinschalige renovatiediensten voor gebruikte gebouwen, externe zones en bijbehorende infrastructuur op zijn hoofdlocatie in Petten en, in mindere mate, in het JRC-clubhuis in Bergen. De contractant voert preventief en correctief onderhoud, reparaties, aanpassingen en kleinschalige renovaties uit met betrekking tot de gebouwen en externe ruimten die door het JRC worden beheerd. De contractant wijst één specifieke voltijdse technicus ter ondersteuning van de faciliteit ter plaatse toe aan de JRC-vestiging in Petten. De technicus voor faciliteitsondersteuning is vijf dagen per week beschikbaar, gedurende ten minste 37 uur per week, tijdens de werkuren die met de sector infrastructuur zijn overeengekomen.

description: This technical facility aims ultimately to the promotion and scale up of the EU Global Gateway offer. The facility will support the global transition to inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in EU's partner countries. The facility will deliver on demand high level technical assistance (TA) in sustainable transport and urban development at country and at regional level through expert missions and studies. TA will be mobilised usually at short notice to improve investment climate and regulatory frameworks and to adopt EU values, standards, knowledge, best practices and innovation. The required expertise and response will vary across the countries and according to the proposed projects or initiatives. The facility will also support knowledge consolidation on sustainable transport and urban development within the EU Commission, development partners and partner countries.

The facility will deliver on demand high level technical assistance (TA) in sustainable transport and urban development at country and at regional level through expert missions and studies. TA will be mobilised usually at short notice to improve investment climate and regulatory frameworks and to adopt EU values, standards, knowledge, best practices and innovation. The required expertise and response will vary across the countries and according to the proposed projects or initiatives. The facility will also support knowledge consolidation on sustainable transport and urban development within the EU Commission, development partners and partner countries.

description: In verband met de leeftijd van de brandmeldinstallatie die in gebouw 312 en 313 geinstalleerd is, dient deze vervangen te worden. Er is geopteerd voor 2 nieuwe systemen, 1 in gebouw 312 en 1 in gebouw 313. Gebouw 312 heeft 5 bouwlagen en bestaat uit kantoren, laboratorium ruimtes en technische ruimtes. Gebouw 313 heeft één bouwlaag en bestaat uit kantoren, een werkplaats, een fitnessruimte en technische ruimtes. Tevens zijn hier serverruimtes aanwezig waar een blusgasinstallatie is aangebracht. Bij gebouw 313 staat gebouw 324 dat gebruikt wordt voor opslag van chemisch afval. De gebouwen 312, 313 en 324 vallen onder deze aanbesteding.

description: The main objective is to enhance efficiency and reliability of the Turkish electricity distribution system (TEDS) through strengthening technical capacity and standardization in line with EU practices. description: ECDC intends to award a contract to support the further development of internal processes for preparing ECDC scientific advice on vaccines. The purpose of the contract is to design a structured process for eliciting Member States’ needs for vaccine‑related advice, to develop a framework guiding the selection of the appropriate category of scientific output, and to support the preparation of a draft multi‑annual plan for ECDC vaccine advice for the period 2027–2030. The work will include pilot testing elements of the new process within the ECDC NITAG Collaboration and the development of supporting documentation. The services aim to ensure a more systematic, transparent, and consistent approach to the planning and production of ECDC’s vaccine‑related scientific advice.

description: BATTES - Battery Abuse Testing for Thermal and Emission Study JRC needs to procure and test different types of batteries. For lot 1, JRC looks to procure and acquire different types of batteries in different sizes (modules and packs). For lot 2, JRC looks to procure to properly instrument and test the batteries from lot 1. Testing will cover different abusive conditions and will aim at evaluating thermal and structural stability. In case of catastrophic failure, an analysis needs to be performed on the type of failure, as well as characterization of the emissions, particulates and possibly post-mortem on the battery itself.

description: Sourcing of data and evidence for policy design and implementation of Trans European Digital Networks (TEN-D) complementing the Cable Projects of European Interest (CPEI) exercise. This study should analyse potential gaps in capacity, resilience and security of terrestrial links, taking into account the expected developments in the field of data centres and other AI facilities as proposed in the Cloud and AI Development Act (CADA). The following identification of infrastructure investment gaps and assessment of potential market failures should lead to recommending the most appropriate interventions, including magnitude and instruments requiring EU funding, under the European Competitiveness Fund (ECF).

description: The European Parliament wishes to support multi-lingual innovation and the digitalisation of all EU official languages through targeted developments. It is therefore aiming to enter into an innovation partnership in order to acquire a licence for a tool that is able to automatically transcribe and translate parliamentary multilingual debates in real time.The tool will also be able to learn from corrections and supporting data as well as from user feedback, so as to enhance quality levels over time. The objective is to provide a useful service for Members of the European Parliament in accessing debates on screen as well as to provide accessibility for deaf and hard of hearing people who currently have no direct access to the debates of the European Parliament.The ultimate goal is to provide an automatic transcription and translation service for parliamentary debates covering the 24 official languages used by the institution.

description: L'OIB cherche une équipe de formateurs pour soutenir l'apprentissage de son personnel de la Commission. La formation s’adresse principalement au personnel de l’OIB, en charge de la mise en œuvre de la politique immobilière et des règles en matière de santé, de sécurité, de prévention et de protection au travail, de protection de l’environnement, des gestionnaires de biens immobiliers et des responsables de l'analyse de risques, de l'identification des dangers et aussi de proposer mesures de préventions (maintenance, construction, rénovation, matières traitées par les conseillers en prévention, etc…).

description: The JRC Karlsruhe plans to sign a contract for a supply of an innert glovebox chain operating under under-pressure for the handling of radionuclides available at the JRC KA. The installation shall follow all regulatory needs in agreement with legal and technical instructions required for nuclear installations in Germany.

description: The EIF operations and information management department is responsible for all middle-and back-office tasks within EIF. The Cash Flow Management Division (OIM-CFM) among other tasks:— administers cash-in and cash-out activities for EIF,— calculates mandate — and deal-level fees,— prepares monthly accruals for all mandates under EIF management,— prepares and sends invoices to all relevant parties,— follows-up with the financial intermediaries on questions regarding provided documentation and data needed to finalize portfolio inclusions and thus validate the paid guarantee fees.The EIF is launching this Procurement procedure to equip OIM-CFM with an encompassing solution (software) and supporting services to fully automate the set-up and calculation of all fees, 4-eyes principle validation workflow, approval workflow, invoice generation and dispatch, system of record data storage and general ledger feed.

description: L’objet de ce marché est de proposer des formations en premiers secours au personnel des institutions européennes au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. Ces formations doivent permettre au personnel d’intervenir efficacement face à une situation d’urgence. Les prestations couvertes par le présent contrat comprennent : • des cours de base en premiers secours ; • des cours de rafraîchissement aux premiers secours ; • des sessions de formation à la réanimation cardio-pulmonaire (RCP) et à l’utilisation d’un défibrillateur automatique externe (DAE).

description: Deliver and present a study for Members of the Regional Development Committee of around 50 pages, focusing on the impacts of the war in Ukraine on EU Border Regions. The study will assess the implications at socio-economic, infrastructure and cohesion policy levels, as well as the vulnerabilities of the affected EU regions. It will also provide recommendations for the post-2027 Cohesion Policy, including possible crisis-response instruments tailored to border regions exposed to geopolitical shocks. Minimum requirements: team of minimum three (3) experts with sound educational/professional qualifications and experience that are clearly relevant to Cohesion Policy and Regional Development. Participation to this procedure is open exclusively to natural and legal persons coming within the scope of the EU Treaties, to natural and legal persons established in a third country which has a special agreement with the EU in the field of public procurement, and to international organisations.

description: The objective of this technical assistance is to implement the gaza central desalination programme on time, on budget and at high quality. The Programme Management Support Consultancy (PMSC) will be embedded in the overall programme management structure. It will support the Palestinian Water Authority (PWA) in programme management and provide guidance during the procurement, design, construction and commissioning phase of the Gaza Central Desalination Programme (GCDP), leading to the Program’s successful implementation and handover to the operational phase. Additionally, this TA aims to enable the long-term operational effectiveness of the GCDP by delivering and implementing a results-driven capacity-building plan to Programme Management Unit that manages and leads the implementation of the GCDP. The estimated duration of the programme is up to 36 months. Up to 3 senior international key experts with experience in managing large water infrastructure Programme will be mobilized.

description: Le Parlement européen est en quête d’une société bancaire qui reprenne une agence bancaire située dans le bâtiment Altiero SPINELLI et un espace situé dans le bâtiment Paul Henri SPAAK, avec l’obligation accessoire de réaliser des services de paiements aux groupes des visiteurs du Parlement européen. L’agence situé dans la galerie intérieure du rez-de-chaussée du bâtiment Altiero SPINELLI du Parlement européen à Bruxelles a une surface de 120 m2. L’agence situé au rez de chaussée du bâtiment Paul Henri SPAAK a une surface de 85 m2. Le contrat de concession sera conclu pour une durée de sept années pour l’agence située dans le bâtiment SPINELLI et de 3 années pour l’agence située dans le bâtiment SPAAK. A l’expiration de la période de trois (3) ans pour l’espace situé dans le bâtiment SPAAK, le Parlement européen pourra mettre à la disposition du contractant un autre espace situé dans le bâtiment ZWEIG pour quatre (4) renouvellements consécutifs d’une année.

Le Parlement européen est en quête d’une société bancaire qui reprenne une agence bancaire située dans le bâtiment Altiero SPINELLI et un espace situé dans le bâtiment Paul Henri SPAAK, avec l’obligation accessoire de réaliser des services de paiements aux groupes des visiteurs du Parlement européen. 
L’agence situé dans la galerie intérieure du rez-de-chaussée du bâtiment Altiero SPINELLI du Parlement européen à Bruxelles a une surface de 120 m2.
L’agence situé au rez de chaussée du bâtiment Paul Henri SPAAK a une surface de 85 m2.
Le contrat de concession sera conclu pour une durée de sept années pour l’agence située dans le bâtiment SPINELLI et de 3 années pour l’agence située dans le bâtiment SPAAK.
A l’expiration de la période de trois (3) ans pour l’espace situé dans le bâtiment SPAAK, le Parlement européen pourra mettre à la disposition du contractant un autre espace situé dans le bâtiment ZWEIG pour quatre (4) renouvellements consécutifs d’une année.

description: 2027 metų pirmąjį pusmetį Lietuva pirmininkaus Europos Vadovų Tarybai. Pasirengimo darbai prasidės 2026 metų lapkričio mėnesį (preliminariai paslaugos bus reikalingos 2026 m. lapkričio 1 d. – 2027 m. liepos 1 d.). Šiuo laikotarpiu Europos Komisijos atstovybei Lietuvoje bus reikalingos transporto priemonių su vairuotoju nuomos paslaugos ir vairuotojo be transporto priemonės nuomos paslaugos. Sutartis bus įgyvendinama ir pasibaigus Pirmininkavimui, tačiau mažesniu intensyvumu.

description: Le présent marché de services concerne une mesure complémentaire de l’appui budgétaire produit par l’Union européenne à la Côte d’Ivoire. L’objectif de cette mesure complémentaire sera d’appuyer l’Etat de Côte d’Ivoire à renforcer la pertinence, l’efficience et l’efficacité des politiques publiques en poursuivant les réformes-clés de modernisation de la Gestion des Finances Publiques et en renforçant les capacités de planification, programmation, suivi évaluation de l’intervention de l’Etat. L’appui se fera sous la forme d’un projet d’assistance technique sur des thématiques telles que la programmation budgétaire, les statistiques, le contrôle interne, la comptabilité matière ou encore le contrôle externe.

description: The purpose of this procurement is to procure services that strengthen and deepen EU–Canada relations on key priority themes of shared strategic interest, while advancing EU interests and values in Canada through targeted policy dialogue and public diplomacy. The contract will support the implementation of commitments under the EU–Canada Strategic Partnership Agreement (SPA), the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), and, where relevant, other bilateral frameworks including the EU–Canada Green Alliance and the EU–Canada Security and Defence Partnership. The procured services shall comprise two complementary components: Policy Dialogue Support — facilitation of structured policy dialogues across a wide range of areas through concrete activities linked to existing and emerging dialogue mechanisms, including joint committees and working groups involving the EU Delegation and relevant EU services. Public Diplomacy Actions — Design and delivery of public diplomacy initiatives aimed at increasing understanding of EU policies and priorities among Canadian audiences, demonstrating the tangible benefits of the EU–Canada partnership, and strengthening engagement with key Canadian stakeholders beyond government — including media, academia, civil society, youth, and opinion leaders. The services shall deliver measurable policy outcomes, consolidate trusted stakeholder networks, and amplify EU positions across Canada. Through the combined effect of policy dialogue and public diplomacy, the procurement aims to enhance the visibility and credibility of the EU in Canada and contribute to closer alignment between EU and Canadian policy positions and approaches, including in multilateral fora, on major foreign policy priorities.

description:
The purpose of this procurement is to procure services that strengthen and deepen EU–Canada relations on key priority themes of shared strategic interest, while advancing EU interests and values in Canada through targeted policy dialogue and public diplomacy.

The contract will support the implementation of commitments under the EU–Canada Strategic Partnership Agreement (SPA), the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), and, where relevant, other bilateral frameworks including the EU–Canada Green Alliance and the EU–Canada Security and Defence Partnership.

The procured services shall comprise two complementary components:

Policy Dialogue Support — facilitation of structured policy dialogues across a wide range of areas through concrete activities linked to existing and emerging dialogue mechanisms, including joint committees and working groups involving the EU Delegation and relevant EU services.

Public Diplomacy Actions — Design and delivery of public diplomacy initiatives aimed at increasing understanding of EU policies and priorities among Canadian audiences, demonstrating the tangible benefits of the EU–Canada partnership, and strengthening engagement with key Canadian stakeholders beyond government — including media, academia, civil society, youth, and opinion leaders.

The services shall deliver measurable policy outcomes, consolidate trusted stakeholder networks, and amplify EU positions across Canada. Through the combined effect of policy dialogue and public diplomacy, the procurement aims to enhance the visibility and credibility of the EU in Canada and contribute to closer alignment between EU and Canadian policy positions and approaches, including in multilateral fora, on major foreign policy priorities.

description: Le Parlement européen lance régulièrement des procédures de passation de marchés publics en vue d’obtenir l’assistance juridique d’un cabinet d’avocats exerçant dans une juridiction spécifique et dans un domaine spécifique du droit. Ces procédures sont régies par les dispositions du règlement (UE, Euratom) 2024/2509 du Parlement européen et du Conseil du 23 septembre 2024 relatif aux règles financières applicables au budget général de l’Union (ci-après: le «RF»). Afin d’identifier les cabinets d’avocats présents sur le marché susceptibles d’être intéressés à représenter le Parlement européen devant les juridictions belges et à fournir une assistance juridique dans les affaires non contentieuses relevant du droit belge, le service juridique du Parlement européen lance un appel à manifestation d’intérêt conformément au point 13.1 b) de l’annexe I du règlement financier.

description: EDA intends to launch a procurement procedure for a framework service contract covering operational planning, management and execution; technical evaluation support; prize-contest administration; and communication and event services, in support of EDA's defence innovation and operational experimentation activities under the Hub for European Defence Innovation (HEDI). The procurement forms part of the EUDIS BraveTech EU initiative, funded by the EU under the European Defence Fund (EDF) and implemented by EDA under indirect management. Its primary object is the BraveTech EU Testing and Evaluation Campaigns (TECS) (Phase 2), announced on 11 July 2025. Building on the Phase 1 DefTech Forges (European Commission call for tenders EC-DEFIS/2025/OP/0040), Phase 2 comprises 16 Operational Experimentation (OPEX) campaigns in which Phase 1 pre-selected companies test and refine their solutions under operational conditions. Campaigns are governed by a prize-contest mechanism under FR (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509, under which EDA's authorising officer awards prizes of up to EUR 1 000 000 per entity to the best-performing solutions. The contractor(s) shall plan, manage and execute the campaigns on EDA's behalf - including calls for host locations, coordination with host-nation authorities and site operators, logistics, spectrum and safety management, evaluation support, reporting, communication and events, and prize-contest administration - across EU Member States and EDF-associated countries over 2026–2028. The framework contract(s) may also be used to order similar services within the scope and maximum value set out in the procurement documents. The contract is not divided into lots. This notice announces EDA's intention to publish a future call for tenders, an information session for economic operators on 3 September 2026, 10:00–12:00 (CET), and the launch of a market survey (RFI). ++++++++ A. Information Session ( https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=X2-UUFRBmkuNd2juNtVUZwsZ5vnJdEJAqruSaWPkOpdUN1VZRTQ2VjZPT1pZQ05QMVRUSkg5MVI4RC4u ) On 3 September 2026, 10:00–12:00 (CET), the European Defence Agency (EDA), through its Hub for European Defence Innovation (HEDI), will hold an Information Session for industry to present the BraveTech EU programme and the Phase 2 procurement approach. The session will cover the procurement strategy and the scope of the forthcoming tender — implementation plan, deliverables, contractual procedures and indicative timeline. The services to be procured cover the operational management of the Operational Experimentation (OPEX) campaigns, including calls for host locations; coordination with host-nation authorities (military or civil) and site operators; logistics and site preparation; spectrum and safety management; technical and operational evaluation support; documentation and reporting; prize-contest administration; and programme communication. The procurement seeks experienced partners to support a large-scale defence technology experimentation programme accelerating the testing, evaluation and operational transition of innovative solutions from European SMEs and start-ups, in response to capability needs identified by EU Member States and Ukraine. More information is provided in Section 2.1.4 "Additional Information" +++++++++++ B. Request for information ( https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/Draft_EDA_Survey_on_National_Defence_Testing_Facilities ) In parallel with the Prior Information Notice, EDA is launching a Request for Information (RFI) / Market Survey directed at testing and experimentation centres, ranges, and related facilities established in EU Member States or EDF-associated countries, that may be considered as potential host locations for BraveTech EU OPEX Campaigns under Phase 2. More information is provided in Section 2.1.4 "Additional Information".

description:
The scope of work is summarised as below:
a) 2600 house connections between the new distribution pipeline and the subscribers” water meter using PE pipes with diameter DN32 to DN 110 and 15.600 m house connection pipe line per an average connection length of approximately 6 m
b) Functional SCADA system consisting of computer hardware and software in compliance with the existing SCADA system of the End Recipient
c) Construction of 16 underground flowmeters, 1 PRV chamber fitted and 7 Residual Chlorine Measurement Equipment
d) Construction of additional water distribution network pipelines diameter DN110 to DN 225 ( appr. 48.500 m ) and DN250 to DN630 (appr.1500m)
e) Construction of 9000 m water mains DN 630 and DN1000
f) Construction of total 18 underground air valves chambers and the discharge valve chambers
g) Installation of 1055 missing valve box
h) Supply and installation of 51 PRV chambers, missing ventilation pipes, missing manometers, missing valves, missing fittings and other items

description: The subject of the contract is a maritime analysis tool to support Frontex’s maritime analysis function by providing capabilities to analyse and derive insights out of ‘big maritime data’. The maritime analytics implies the competent use of the system to support the development and implementation of risk profiles as well as to identify and monitor areas used as embarkation or transit points for irregular migration and cross-border crime. The maritime analytics system should provide a user-friendly interface and include the integration and fusion of data/information from an increased number of sources. In addition, it is requested to enable customized search rules and queries based on specific ship behaviours. The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) are included in Annex-I. According to the Maritime Analysis Tool ToR (see Annex-I), the ‘usability requirements’ are listed as the following functionalities from the risk analysis perspective that the Maritime Analysis Tool should provide to Frontex analysts: a. to capture, store and manage global maritime big data, for at least 5 years previous to the query. b. to fuse and integrate maritime ’big data’ with vessels’ historical data, for at least 5 years previous to the query. c. To allow the export of the query results with the highest available limit - at least 10.000 entries.

description: The European Parliament launches this procedure aiming to award a framework contract for daily monitoring of written press (national/regional), audio-visual media (radio, TV) and the main online media (internet) in Italy. The purpose is to provide a timely, up-to-date compendium of daily information, in the form of press reviews, about the way in which topics of relevance to the European Parliament and the European Union are reported in the media. The European Parliament’s Directorate-General for Communication is seeking to ensure it has the best possible knowledge of the media coverage across the EU on topics related to the European Union, the European Parliament and the activities of its President and Members. Media analysis will ultimately help the EP to better communicate EU policies to EU citizens and specific target audiences. In order to achieve this, the EP relies partly on external expertise and assistance. The services will be delivered by the external team via the global media monitoring and analysis platform of the EP directly to the recipients.

description: JRC Petten replaces various equipment each year as part of an annual upgrade procedure. Items that are more than 4 years old and fully depreciated need to be removed from service as they are EOL, outside of maintenance or surplus to requirements as the activity has been completed. In some cases the equipment may still be functioning and the preference would be to dispose of such items where necessary to non-profit organizations, rather than simply throwing them away. The objective of this call for expressions of interest is to set up a list of pre-selected candidates for donation of reusable and recyclable goods to non-profit organisations for humanitarian, social, charity or environmental purposes.

description: The main objective of this project is to enhance sustainability, financial viability and social impact of Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) and non-state actors supporting social needs-driven development. This project will: • strengthen skills and knowledge on social entrepreneurship of (CSOs) and social enterprises, promote partnerships/networking between CSOs and social enterprises working in the same social domain and raise public awareness on social entrepreneurship; • strengthen institutional, policy and regulatory framework related to social entrepreneurship in Türkiye. For this purpose, various capacity building and awareness raising activities, such as, organization of trainings, workshops, networking events and study visits, provision of consultancy services and development of tools will be realised in line with technical studies, plans, policy papers and reports that are also expected to be prepared by the contractor under this contract.

description: The European Parliament regularly launches public procurement procedures with a view to obtaining legal assistance from a law firm practicing in a specific jurisdiction and in a specific area of law. These procedures are governed by the provisions of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 September 2024 on the financial rules applicable to the general budget of the Union (hereinafter: the ‘FR’). In order to identify law firms on the market that may be interested in representing the European Parliament before Lithuanian courts and providing legal assistance in non-contentious cases under Lithuanian law, the Legal Service of the European Parliament is launching a call for expressions of interest in accordance with point 13.1(b) of Annex I to the FR.

description: The European Parliament launches this procedure aiming to award a framework contract for daily monitoring of written press (national/regional), audio-visual media (radio, TV) and the main online media (internet) in Ireland. The purpose is to provide a timely, up-to-date compendium of daily information, in the form of press reviews, about the way in which topics of relevance to the European Parliament and the European Union are reported in the media. The European Parliament’s Directorate-General for Communication is seeking to ensure it has the best possible knowledge of the media coverage across the EU on topics related to the European Union, the European Parliament and the activities of its President and Members. Media analysis will ultimately help the EP to better communicate EU policies to EU citizens and specific target audiences. In order to achieve this, the EP relies partly on external expertise and assistance. The services will be delivered by the external team via the global media monitoring and analysis platform of the EP directly to the recipients.

description: Le Parlement européen est à la recherche d’une agence bancaire qui devra s’installer dans son complexe immobilier à Strasbourg. Les espaces bancaires seront mis à disposition à titre gratuit ; cependant, le concessionnaire sera tenu de régler sa quote-part dans les charges liées à l'exploitation des locaux en question (quote-part de la consommation d'électricité et d'eau, ainsi que des frais de nettoyage, maintenance et gardiennage de l'immeuble). En cas de modification des surfaces, la redevance sera recalculée en conséquence. Cette quote-part forfaitaire s'élève à 160 € par m2 par an. La concession sera attribuée à l’offre économiquement la plus avantageuse parmi celles négociées avec les sociétés bancaires dont les qualifications seront en adéquation avec le concept recherché par le Parlement européen.

description: The objective is to conduct a system study to define the architecture and design the system of a Quantum Communication Infrastructure (QCI) for both the Terrestrial and Space segments. The tender will provide a roadmap for the deployment of the architecture with the key technologies and technology components required for the terrestrial and space segment, including R&D efforts. The costs and timelines associated to the different phases of the deployment will be explained and detailed. The architecture will have to be modular and scalable to include any new application or technology when available. This tender is part of a coordinated call with the European Space Agency (ESA) which will launch the same study but for the space segment of the architecture. The present call addresses only the terrestrial segment.

description: Regulation (EU) 2021/887 of the European Parliament and of the Council established the European Cybersecurity Industrial, Technology and Research Competence Centre (ECCC) and the Network of National Coordination Centres (NCCs) to strengthen the Union’s leadership and strategic autonomy in cybersecurity (hereinafter “the Regulation”). The Regulation entrusts the ECCC with the coordination of Union cybersecurity research, innovation, and industrial activities, notably under the Digital Europe Programme (DEP) and Horizon Europe. Pursuant to Article 38(2) of the Regulation, the European Commission shall prepare an implementation report, which will be submitted to the European Parliament and to the Council The implementation report shall take into account the preliminary input of the Governing Board, the national coordination centres and the Community. The Competence Centre and Member States shall provide the Commission with the information necessary for the preparation of that report. On the basis of the conclusions of the implementation report, the Commission may take appropriate actions. The contract concerns the provision of external expertise, information and data gathering and analytical support for the drafting of the above-mentioned implementation report. The contractor shall support with gathering of information and evidence, related assessment and drafting of the implementation report. The overall objective of the resulting contract would be to support the Commission in preparing the Article 38(2) implementation report and assessment of the ECCC by delivering robust, traceable evidence and analytical inputs. Maximum total contract value: 139,500 EUR.

description: The European Parliament launches this procedure aiming to award a framework contract for daily monitoring of written press (national/regional), audio-visual media (radio, TV) and the main online media (internet) in Greece. The purpose is to provide a timely, up-to-date compendium of daily information, in the form of press reviews, about the way in which topics of relevance to the European Parliament and the European Union are reported in the media. The European Parliament’s Directorate-General for Communication is seeking to ensure it has the best possible knowledge of the media coverage across the EU on topics related to the European Union, the European Parliament and the activities of its President and Members. Media analysis will ultimately help the EP to better communicate EU policies to EU citizens and specific target audiences. In order to achieve this, the EP relies partly on external expertise and assistance. The services will be delivered by the external team via the global media monitoring and analysis platform of the EP directly to the recipients.

description: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to improve conditions for the EU agro-food sector to access the markets of selected key trading partners, by increasing the mutual understanding of their respective sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) measures of the EU and of the third countries. The services to be provided in the Framework contract consist of study visits of officials from third countries to the EU and activities of market access analysis in the SPS field.

to access the markets of selected key trading partners, by increasing the mutual understanding of their

countries to the EU and activities of market access analysis in the SPS field.

description: The European Parliament regularly launches public procurement procedures with a view to obtaining legal assistance from a law firm practicing in a specific jurisdiction and in a specific area of law. These procedures are governed by the provisions of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 September 2024 on the financial rules applicable to the general budget of the Union (hereinafter: the ‘FR’). In order to identify law firms on the market that may be interested in representing the European Parliament before Estonian courts and providing legal assistance in non-contentious cases under Estonian law, the Legal Service of the European Parliament is launching a call for expressions of interest in accordance with point 13.1(b) of Annex I to the FR.

description: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) is a decentralised agency of the European Union (EU). It is responsible for the scientific evaluation, supervision and safety monitoring of medicines. EMA operates from its Headquarters in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. EMA is evaluating the possibility of launching in the future a tender procedure for the procurement of services related to the planning, organization, and delivery of tabletop exercises in the fields of physical security, crisis management and business continuity. The services would be related to tabletop exercises having as baseline scenarios major security incidents occurring at the EMA premises and/or in the hosting environment (Amsterdam, North Holland, The Netherlands), or any other serious incident or event potentially affecting the normal operations of the Agency or the safety and security of its personnel, assets, information and operations, either in The Netherlands, Europe or Worldwide. Additional information: Preliminary market research: Please note that EMA is running preliminary market research as part of the evaluation process on whether to launch the above-mentioned procurement procedure. The market research is intended to foster EMA’s understanding of services available in the market as well the characteristics of the economic operators delivering said services. Economic operators interested in participating in this preliminary market research are invited to complete the online questionnaire which is available under this link: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/9c914c8c-aa26-f8b6-94d1-baec5caef030 The market research is open for contribution from 24 August 2026 08:00 and the deadline to participate in the online questionnaire is 30 September 2026 at 13.00. Participation in the survey is not a prerequisite to submit a tender if the procurement procedure will be published. Participating to the market research in no case implies a commitment from the European Medicines Agency to procure services to any participant, and no costs can be charged to the European Medicines Agency as a result of the participation to the market research. The economic operators commit to provide the answers at their own cost, purely for commercial awareness purposes and decline to advance any liability or demand any financial commitment to the European Medicines Agency. The European Medicines Agency will process all information provided by participants confidentially and will exercise due diligence to protect it accordingly. Information provided by participants will be made available internally only to the Agency's Security, Crisis Management, Business Continuity and Procurement staff and will not be disclosed in any case to third parties. Please note the following: - It is not possible at this stage to provide the maximum contract value as this depends on the market survey results. - the launch date indicated in this PIN is only an estimate.

description: The subject of this call for tenders is the provision of services to support and implement the LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) 2027. The Commission Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey (LUCAS) is an EU-wide, in-situ field survey that systematically captures detailed information on land cover, land use and other agri-environmental parameters — providing an essential evidence base for the design, implementation and monitoring progress of EU policies.

description: The objective of this call for tenders is to award a service framework contract to a single economic operator for the production and supply of geospatial products for the Copernicus security service component on support to EU external and security actions (‘the Copernicus SESA Service’). The SatCen, as the manager and coordinator of the Copernicus SESA service, seeks to acquire services to provide rapid and on-demand geospatial products based on the analysis of satellite imagery and collateral data for the detection and monitoring of events or activities that may have implications for the EU and global security. Such products include, inter alia, layers, maps and databases under different formats.

description:
The objective of this call for tenders is to award a service framework contract to a single economic operator for the production and supply of geospatial products for the Copernicus security service component on support to EU external and security actions (‘the Copernicus SESA Service’). 

The SatCen, as the manager and coordinator of the Copernicus SESA service, seeks to acquire services to provide rapid and on-demand geospatial products based on the analysis of satellite imagery and collateral data for the detection and monitoring of events or activities that may have implications for the EU and global security. Such products include, inter alia, layers, maps and databases under different formats.

description: L’objet du présent marché vise : - la conception graphique et la mise en page d’éléments de signalétique, y compris de plans d’évacuation, ainsi que la modification d’éléments de signalétique existants ; - la réalisation et la transmission des bons à tirer pour approbation, et/ou la fourniture d’épreuves sous forme de fichiers DAO informatiques de type PDF, JPEG, DWG, DXF ou autres à préciser ; - la fabrication, la fourniture, la livraison et la pose ; - la protection, durant toute la durée des chantiers, de leur environnement direct, par un matériau suffisamment résistant afin d’éviter toute dégradation ; - le nettoyage final des éléments de signalétique et du site (environnement direct : sols, murs, plafonds…) ; - la réalisation de dossiers as built ; - des prestations en régie pour un technicien qualifié en signalétique.

description: The Representation in Dublin needs support to compile and maintain up-to-date contact lists for journalists and media production staff in Ireland. Such a database of contacts is needed for the Representation to identify appropriate categories of journalists to receive press releases and event/briefing invitations. This would help the Representation Press team ensure that they are targeting the correct audience to optimise the impact and take-up of Press Releases and invitations. Since it is not feasible to maintain such a database within the Representation, it is necessary for the Representation to outsource the compilation and management of this database for media contacts to a specialised contractor.

description: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) is a decentralised agency of the European Union responsible for the scientific evaluation, supervision and safety monitoring of medicines. EMA operates from its headquarters at Domenico Scarlattilaan 6, 1083 HS Amsterdam, The Netherlands. EMA intends to launch an open tender procedure for the provision of security services at its premises in Amsterdam. The current framework contract for these services expires in the second half of 2027 and the new contract is expected to start on 1 September 2027. The services to be procured comprise permanent security guarding of the EMA premises, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, delivered by a dedicated on-site team consisting of a security operational manager and assistant, shift supervisors and security guards, including reception, access control, screening of persons, mail and luggage, patrols, control room operation, incident response and security administration support; additional ad hoc guarding for events and for periods of increased activity; rental of security screening equipment (X-ray scanners, walk-through metal detectors, mobile fencing, portable CCTV) with trained operators, for events; supply of security consumables and devices (access cards, lanyards, card holders and similar items); and security emergency services: rapid deployment of additional guarding capacity and equipment in case of a security crisis. The contract will take the form of a multiple framework contract in cascade, for an initial duration of two years, renewable twice for one year (four years in total). The estimated value given in this notice is indicative and non-binding and may change in the contract notice. Points which interested economic operators may wish to consider in advance of the publication of the contract notice: Services must be delivered in accordance with Dutch legislation on private security (Wet particuliere beveiligingsorganisaties en recherchebureaus), including the authorisation of the company and the licensing and screening of all guarding personnel. Tenderers must hold the relevant authorisation at the time of submission. A change of contractor may give rise to a transfer of undertaking under Dutch law and the applicable collective labour agreement for the private security sector. Information on the personnel currently deployed will be made available with the tender documents so that all tenderers can assess this on an equal basis. The contract places strong emphasis on the recruitment, training, retention and development of the security team, on service levels measured through key performance indicators, and on sustainability in the supply of consumables. The award will be based on the best price-quality ratio with a predominant weighting for quality. The contract will be concluded on the basis of EMA's standard framework contract, with special conditions adapted to security services, including a liability regime tailored to the Dutch security market. The tender documents will be published in English. A site visit will be organised during the submission period. The contract notice and the complete procurement documents will be published in the Official Journal of the European Union and on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal. Economic operators interested in this procedure are invited to register on the Funding & Tenders Portal, to obtain a Participant Identification Code (PIC) if they do not already have one, and to subscribe to the procedure once published in order to receive notifications. The launch date indicated in this notice is an estimate. This prior information notice does not constitute a call for competition and does not oblige EMA to launch the procedure; no contact with economic operators will take place outside the official publication channels.

description: Euroopa päeva kontserdi ja festivaliala korraldamine Narvas 9. mail 2027 Keskmise maksumusega hankemenetlus Käesoleva hanke eesmärk on leida pakkuja Euroopa päeva kontserdi ja festivaliala korraldamiseks 9. mail 2027 Narva Raekoja platsil. Hankijaks on Euroopa Komisjoni Eesti esindus (edaspidi Tellija). Mais 2027 tähistatakse Eestis taas Euroopa päeva avalike üritustega Tallinnas ja Narvas, rõhutades 9. maid kui rahu ja ühtsuse päeva Euroopas. Eelmiste aastate õnnestunud kogemusele tuginedes pakub Euroopa päeva programm erinevatele sihtrühmadele suunatud kaasavaid tegevusi ning võimalusi tutvuda Euroopa riikide ja kultuuridega. Ülevaate varasemate aastate Euroopa päeva üritustest leiab veebilehelt www.euroopapäev.ee. Euroopa Komisjoni Eesti esindus soovib hankida täisteenust Euroopa päeva suurejooneliseks tähistamiseks Narvas, mis hõlmab meelelahutusliku ja hariva ürituse terviklikku korraldamist. Hange näeb ette Euroopa päeva kontserdiprogrammi loomist, ettevalmistusi ja tehnilist teostust, sh ERR otseülekande tehnilise teostuse toetamist, festivaliala ülesehitust ning tehnilist tuge võimalike kõrvalürituste korraldamiseks nii Euroopa päeva ettevalmistusperioodi ajal kui ka Euroopa nädala jooksul. Lepingu maht ja maksumus Pakkumismenetluse alusel tehtavate tegevuste maksimaalne kogumaksumus on 115 000 (sada viisteist tuhat) eurot. Hind ei sisalda käibemaksu. Lepingu kestus Pakkumismenetluse tulemusena sõlmitud leping sõlmitakse kuni 7 kuuks vahemikus 30.11.2026 kuni 1.juuni 2027. Hanke väljakuulutamine: oktoober 2026 F&T Portal ja eSubmission Lepingu sõlmimise tähtaeg: 31.12.2026 Küsimused hanke kohta: COMM-REP-TLL-HANKED@EC.EUROPA.EU

description: Disclaimer: the description of the nature and scope of the services and supplies of the Space Traffic Coordination Platform procurement is only indicative, aimed at outlining the concept in broad terms and it may need substantial adjustments. Therefore it shall not be considered final nor binding. The EU Platform for Space Traffic Coordination aims to address the exponential increase in active satellites and the associated risks of orbital collisions, including those posed by large constellations. The initiative seeks to structure, secure and expand coordination between satellite operators, public entities and commercial SSA providers, building on existing services developed under EU Space Surveillance and Tracking (EU SST). It is intended to extend coordination beyond current EU SST members by enabling the collection and processing of key information, such as contact details and manoeuvre data from non-registered or international actors. The proposed platform should facilitate the secure, real-time exchange of operational data and ensure interoperability between the different actors involved in space traffic activities. The action should include the implementation of a sandbox to test and assess the “rules of the road”, providing a controlled environment to evaluate their practical application and support validation prior to broader implementation. In addition, the initiative will include engagement and awareness-raising activities aimed at identifying the needs and expectations of EU Member States, satellite operators and SSA providers (public and private).

description: The contract aims to provide support to the Ministry of Environment, Sustainable Development and Northern Region Development as the key institution, along with other relevant national stakeholders, in the preparation of high-quality infrastructure project documentation in the environmental sector, contributing to improved maturity of the Environment and Climate Change Project Pipeline. This support will be aligned with national regulations governing environmental planning and construction, as well as relevant EU standards and sectoral policies. The project will deliver a comprehensive package of preparatory activities, including assessments of project relevance and maturity (gap assessments), preparation of technical documentation (such as feasibility studies and designs), development of tender dossiers, and support in drafting Operation Identification Sheets (OISs) and applications for major projects where applicable. In addition to technical support, the project will provide expert advice and operational assistance to public beneficiaries and operators involved in planned investments. The Project will also assist in the development of monitoring tools to support the implementation of investment projects and contribute to enhanced coordination in the planning, preparation, implementation, and operation of investments in the environment sector. Capacity building will be an integral part of the project, through targeted coaching, workshops, and on-the-job training, aimed at strengthening institutional capacities for project preparation and investment management.

description: The aim of this contract is to generate policy-relevant evidence on how generative Artificial Intelligence (gen-AI) shapes both the supply of, and demand for, argumentative information in the European Union. To this end, the Contractor will: (1) run a large-scale experimental online survey to measure how real-time interactions with AI chatbots influence individual beliefs, reasoning and attitudes on EU policy issues; and (2) create a multilingual Human-AI Argumentation Corpus of texts written by professional writers, with and without AI support, and run an evaluation survey to quantify how AI-use transparency disclosures affect persuasion, confirmation bias, and information selection.

description: The purpose of this framework contract is to provide the EEA with scientific, technical, analytical and coordination support for the implementation, assessment, quality assurance, integration, further development and uptake of activities related to the CLMS and the Copernicus In-Situ Component. The services shall support the EEA in carrying out its entrusted Copernicus tasks and in responding to evolving operational, technical and policy needs throughout the duration of the framework contract. Activities may include analyses, methodological developments, investigations, testing, pilot exercises and other support activities contributing to the effective implementation and continuous improvement of CLMS and Copernicus In-Situ activities.
