description: The European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA) is planning to launch a call for tender for the provision of an overview of regulation, policies, strategies, initiatives and programmes for the prevention of work-related cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). The overall objectives of the contract to be awarded are to: • Identify and describe regulation, policies, strategies, initiatives and programmes at EU, Member State, regional, social partner and sectoral levels that have been implemented for the prevention of work-related CVDs, the return-to-work of workers after a CVD or the retention at work of workers with chronic CVDs. The overview should cover regulation, policies, strategies, initiatives and programmes related to OSH as well as those in other policy fields such as public health, environment, etc. as relevant. • Analyse and describe a minimum of 4 case examples/best practices fostering the prevention of work-related CVDs, the return-to-work of workers after a CVD or the retention at work of workers with chronic CVDs. The case examples should include: background /introduction, aims of the initiative, what was done and how, what was achieved, success factors and challenges, transferability, further information, references and resources. • Identify gaps and needs and provide recommendations for policy regarding the prevention of work-related CVDs, the return-to-work of workers after a CVD or the retention at work of workers with chronic CVDs. The information and case examples on regulation, policies, strategies, initiatives and programmes will be collected through desk and fieldwork research. The expected deliverables are: • A final report of approximately 50 pages or 55,000 words maximum (excluding the executive summary and references). • A stand-alone executive summary (four pages maximum) based on the content of the final report. • A minimum of 4 individual case studies/examples to be published as stand-alone documents (deliverable for publication, total length about 5-6 pages, 20.000 characters, with spaces each). • A policy brief of maximum 4-5 pages. • A PowerPoint presentation highlighting the main issues and recommendations. This should be suitable for a non-technical audience. The PowerPoint slides will be drafted using good presentational practice, keeping text to the headlines on the slides and putting further detail in speaker’s notes. The presentation should have a maximum of 15 slides and will be prepared using the template and guidelines for accessible PowerPoint presentations provided by the contracting authority to the winning tenderer once the contract has been awarded. The maximum total budget available for the contract to be awarded is EUR 40.000 (excluding VAT). It is possible to express interest as an individual organisation or a consortium. However please note that invited candidates can submit a joint tender with other economic operators only if they have expressed interest in the planned procedure as a consortium. More information regarding the participation rules can be found in the link "More information can be found here." Please find the selection criteria for this procedure in the following address: https://osha.europa.eu/en/about-eu-osha/procurement/osha2025lvp0002-exa-overview-regulation-policies-strategies-initiatives-and-programmes-prevention-work-related-cvds-low-value-procedure

description: Le présent marché porte sur la mobilisation d’une assistance technique, afin d'appuyer la gestion et la mise en œuvre du programme Msomo Na Hazi — formation et insertion professionnelle — en Union des Comores. L'objectif du projet est de faire évoluer durablement l’offre de formation pour mieux répondre aux besoins du marché de travail et créer des opportunités d’auto-emploi pour les jeunes comoriens de 15-35 ans, à travers une approche centrée sur l’insertion des apprenants, le renforcement des capacités et la concertation entre le secteur public-privé et la société civile. L'assistance technique appuiera notamment: 1) la gestion administrative et financière, suivi-évaluation, coordination et communication;2) l'élaboration de parcours formation et insertion;3) les centres publics et acteurs institutionnels de la formation technique et professionnelle;4) les initiatives de la société civile et du secteur privé;5) la gouvernance multipartite et expérimentation du financement public.

description: The objective of the contract is to support the National Statistical Systems (NSS) of the Southern Neighbourhood countries to develop and produce reliable and comparable statics, in line with European and international norms and standards, and thereby improve both the availability and quality of statistical data from the Southern Neighbourhood countries and their dissemination to policy-makers, other users and the wider public.Technical assistance to the national statistical systems of the Southern Neighbourhood countries will be delivered through a number of regional or country-specific activities aimed at strengthening the countries statistical systems: trainings; provision of expert advice; support to data collection and dissemination; organisation of meetings, seminars and workshops to discuss problems in producing statistics in accordance with the European and international norms and standards.

description: Dans le but d'améliorer la gestion durable de ses ressources forestières, la République du Congo s'est engagée en 2008 dans la négociation d'un Accord de partenariat volontaire (APV) pour l’application des réglementations forestières, la gouvernance et les échanges commerciaux (FLEGT en acronyme anglais pour Forest Law Enforcement, Governance and Trade) avec l'Union européenne. L'accord est entré officiellement en vigueur le 1.3.2013.Le Système de vérification de la légalité (SVL) de l'APV de la République du Congo est composé de six éléments dont un audit indépendant. Depuis 2015, un Auditeur indépendant du système (AIS) est présent en République du Congo dans le but de s'assurer de la performance et de l'efficience du système de vérification de la légalité en cours de mise en œuvre. Le précédent contrat étant arrivé à échéance en 2019, le présent marché vise à mobiliser un nouvel auditeur indépendant.

description: Subject of procurement is the development of a financial benchmark to assess the commercial viability of digital submarine cables. The study will serve as an input for the evaluation of funding applications under the Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) Digital programme, specifically under the future Digital Global Gateways call for proposals. It will gather data about past commercial projects and collect opinions from market players. After clean up and triangulation of the data collected to ensure comparability, the study will calculate the historical average investment return of cable system projects and run statistical analysis to identify key profitability drivers. The study is expected to determine an expected/benchmark return on investment that would be used to compare the profitability of the projects being evaluated and assess how much they rely on public funds to be rolled out. Maximum total value of the contract: 50 000 EUR and Maximum Duration: 4 months

description: The European Observatory for Nanomaterials (EUON) aims at improving the transparency of information on the safety and markets of nanomaterials. Via annual stakeholder consultations, EUON identifies study topics to address important knowledge gaps and regulatory-relevant uncertainties on nanomaterials. These studies are conducted to collect and analyse information obtained from systematic literature reviews, complemented with consultations of relevant experts. This specific study aims to collect, analyse, and critically review available scientific information and data concerning occupational exposure to nanomaterials, including those released from products and articles incorporating nanomaterials, across a broad range of professional sectors. The assessment is meant to cover all types of nanomaterials, irrespective of their chemical nature. The objective is to evaluate the current state of knowledge, identify existing specific data gaps, and propose potential regulatory and non-regulatory measures to limit occupational exposure. Overall, this study will provide a structured overview of potential occupational exposure scenarios and associated risks related to nanomaterials and nano-enabled products. The findings will serve as a knowledge baseline to support potential future policy development, regulatory considerations, and occupational health and safety decision-making. You are kindly informed that : • Participation in ECHA’s call for tenders is open on equal terms to all natural and legal persons registered and with legal personality in the Member States of the European Union as well as to international organizations. • It is also open to all natural and legal persons established in a third country which has a special agreement with the European Union in the field of public procurement on the conditions laid down in that agreement. This procedure is, however, not covered by the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA). For this procedure, this means economic operators established in a country under a Stabilisation and Association Agreements or in the EEA Agreement. • The rules on access to procurement do not apply to subcontractors. Subcontracting may not be used with the intent to circumvent the rules on access to procurement. • Tenderers must ensure that none of the involved entities are subject to EU restrictive measures adopted under Article 29 of the Treaty on the European Union (TEU) or Article 215 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU (TFEU). The prohibition applies throughout the whole performance of the contract. Candidates which do not fulfil the above-mentioned conditions may not be invited to participate to the following invitation to tender. Candidates are reminded that the publication of an ex-ante publicity notice does not guarantee that ECHA will launch a tender on the subject it covers.

These studies are conducted to collect and analyse information obtained from systematic literature reviews, complemented with consultations of relevant experts.

This specific study aims to collect, analyse, and critically review available scientific information and data concerning occupational exposure to nanomaterials, including those released from products and articles incorporating nanomaterials, across a broad range of professional sectors. description: The European Union Agency for Asylum (EUAA) requires the provision of Relocation and Move Support Services (Lot 1) and Warehousing and Distribution Services (Lot 2) in Malta as described in Part 2 – Technical Specifications. description: The aim of this contract is to sign 1 or more (1 per lot) framework contract(s) to carry out works with maintenance services in the field of fire safety — fire detection, fire alarm and fire control — in European Parliament buildings in Brussels.The contractor must install, programme and maintain new fire detection, fire alarm and fire control systems.The European Parliament's building maintenance services in Brussels are seeking a contractor who will be the sole contact and fits the following profile:— be a manufacturer in the fire detection and fire alarm field. These capacities are internal to the contractor and cannot be outsourced,— be a manufacturer or subcontract manufacturing in the fire control field,— be able to take responsibility for the performance of work and maintenance assignments in the fields of fire detection, fire alarm and fire control,— coordinating with other third parties, internal services or contractors of the European Parliament who are responsible for installing or maintaining technical equipment related to systems of fire detection, fire alarm and fire control,— advising the European Parliament's building maintenance services in order to comply with and meet the contractual objectives.For the entire contract duration, the reverse compatibility of all fire detection, fire alarm and fire control systems and equipment that have already been installed must be ensured when new equipment and systems are commissioned.The contract covers all buildings occupied by the European Parliament in Brussels and is divided into 2 lots. Candidates may tender either for 1 of the 2 lots (lot 1, lot 2) or for both lots (lots 1 and 2).The first lot (lot 1) represents a total initial surface area of ± 362 000 m2 (including basements), spread over 4 buildings. The second lot (lot 2) represents a total initial surface area of ± 300 000 m2 (including basements), spread over 12 buildings. During the contract, the European Parliament reserves the right to withdraw or to add buildings of the site to either lot.

description: The aim of the contract is the signature of a framework contract in order to carry out works with maintenance services in the field of centralised technical management for European Parliament buildings in Brussels.The contractor shall install, program and provide maintenance for a new technical building management system (TBMS) at the European Parliament site in Brussels.Candidates will apply in their capacities as a:— manufacturer,— installer,— maintenance provider.Entities of the candidate with these capacities are hereinafter referred to as 'the manufacturing entity', 'the installing entity' and 'the maintenance entity'.The European Parliament's maintenance services in Brussels want a contractor who is the sole contact and fits the following profile:— is a manufacturer in the field of control and technical building management.The manufacturing capacities are internal and cannot be subcontracted,— is an expert, by way of its products and services, in applications such as heating, ventilation, air conditioning, electricity distribution and lighting,— is able to take responsibility for carrying out the works assignments and maintenance summarised above:• by coordinating with other third parties, internal services or European Parliament contractors who are responsible for maintaining or fitting technical installations related to control and TBM;• by advising the European Parliament's building maintenance services in order to comply with and meet the contractual objectives.It is required to ensure, for the duration of the contract:— the reverse compatibility of all terminal control equipment that has already been installed when new equipment is commissioned,— the homogeneity and uniqueness of the technical building management system, integrating several CTM subsystems and based on BACNet.The contract covers all buildings occupied by the European Parliament in Brussels and is divided into 2 lots. Candidates may tender either for one of the 2 lots (lot 1, lot 2) or for both lots (lot 1 and lot 2).During the course of the contract, the European Parliament reserves the right to withdraw or to add site buildings to either of the 2 lots.

Definition of the criterion:§1. Criterion CS-MAN02 — Manufacture and supply specific product types required for the contract:i. Definition of the criterion:§1. For this contract, each candidate must provide, for each of the 5 product types listed below and meeting selection criterion CS-MAN01 and the following minimum requirements:Product type No 1 — 'TBM monitoring and supervision software' ('Management' level):— the number of addressable points (physical and data, including terminal control) in the system that the software should be able to handle is incidence history, records and trends) is not limited.Product type No 2 — 'Digital building controller' ('Automation' level):— this product type enables the management and coordination, on a BACnet/MSTP or BACnet/LonTalk subnet, of a set of controllers in the 'Automation' level, while connected with the 'Management' level in BACnet via VLAN Ethernet IP,— it enables at least 30 controllers to connect to the subnet,— it provides the subnet with calendar and scheduling functions, as well as recording and trend functions,— it incorporates a real-time clock,— it can be configured if several similar devices are available on the site, in order to coordinate data display,— it is fitted with an embedded web server allowing multiple simultaneous connections.Product type No 3 — 'Digital controller for primary and secondary applications ('Automation' level):— this product type is suitable for HVAC applications (such as the control of air handling units, boiler rooms, refrigeration units and cooling towers, collectors and pumps, etc.),— it is connected (upstream) to a digital building controller in a BACnet/MSTP or BACnet/LonTalk subnet in the 'Automation' level,— it is freely programmable,— it incorporates a real-time clock,— its capacity (possibly with exit/entry module extensions) is above or equal to 48 physical points (≥ 24 BI and ≥ 8 BO and ≥ 8 AI and ≥ 8AO),— it includes (or enables connection to) a human-machine interface (LCD display and control/navigation buttons).Product type No 4 — 'Digital controller for terminal applications' ('Automation' level):— it is suitable for HVAC applications such as the control of terminal units (4-tube fan coil with motion sensor and window contact, lighting control relay),— it is connected (upstream) to a digital building controller in a BACnet/MSTP or BACnet/LonTalk subnet in the 'Automation' level,— its capacity (possibly with exit/entry module extensions) is above or equal to 8 physical points (≥ 2 BI and ≥ 3 BO and ≥ 1 AI and ≥ 2AO).Product type No 5 — 'Integration system controller' ('Automation' level):— this product type enables the management and coordination, on a LonWorks or KNX subnet, of a set of controllers in the 'Automation' level, while connected with the 'Management' level in BACnet via VLAN Ethernet IP,— it enables at least 30 controllers to connect to the subnet,— it provides the subnet with calendar and scheduling functions, as well as recording and trend functions,— it incorporates a real-time clock.ii. Definition of the criterion:§1. The candidate is an authorised and ranked works contractor, currently and for at least 5 years from the date of publication of the contract notice, in accordance with the provisions of the the Belgian Ministerial Decree of 27.9.1991 (or equivalent in the candidate's country of origin) in each of the following categories and classes:— Category P1 'Electrical installations in buildings': class 4 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or class 3 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— Category S4 'IT equipment': class 4 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or class 3 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).§2. Subcontracting of installation services is permitted.ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-INST01]:§1. [INSTentragr] For each installing entity that the candidate proposes for the contract, he shall provide copies proving that the contractor is authorised for the period and as described above.§2. [INSTresp] Should it propose several installing entities, the candidate shall indicate for each entity the type of relationship, tasks and responsibilities that it is planning with this entity. If one of the installing entities proposed is a subcontractor, the applicant shall indicate it here.b. Criterion CS-INST02 — Have already installed control products and TBM systems:i. Definition of the criterion:The candidate shall provide proof of his capacity to install control products and TBM systems, by demonstrating that he has provided 2 works services in the past.Works reference No 1 — Carrying out new works:— in a single building,— the value of the works is at least 400 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 200 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).Works reference No 2 — Carrying out renovation works:— in one or more buildings, all occupied during the works,— the value of the works is at least 640 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 320 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).Each reference submitted shall have the following characteristics as a minimum:— the works must have been accepted (provisional acceptance or equivalent) in the 5 years prior to the date of publication of the contract notice,— the works must have been carried out in a Member State of the European Union (EU28),— the works must involve:• electrical installations (cabling and electrical switchboards, installation and connection of electrical fixtures, commissioning and operational tests);• for control products and TBM IT systems (automation and supervision),— TBM products and systems must cover at least the 2 following levels:• 'Management';• 'Automation',— the applications covered by the products and TBM systems must refer to at least 3 of the 4 following technological fields related to buildings:(a) heating/ventilation/air conditioning/blinds/water and sanitation;(b) electricity distribution/lighting;(c) refrigeration for catering;(d) management of energy and water flows,— the works must be subject to a certificate of satisfactory performance, signed and dated by the client,— the total treated surface area is at least 24 000 m2 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 12 000 m2 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— the number of points addressed and managed in the new installation exceeds 4 800 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or 2 400 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-INST02]:The candidate must provide, for each reference given above, a summary [INSTreftravn] (with Nos 1 or 2) specifying as a minimum:— the start date for services and the date of provisional acceptance,— the place of performance,— the purpose of the services,— the control and TBM products placed, their references and numbers, the levels ('management', 'automation', 'site') and the technological fields covered,— the number of points (physical and data, including terminal control),— the attestations of conformity and satisfactory performance,— the value (including items and workforce) (excluding taxes), broken down into:— the electrician works on the one hand,— and on the other, the supply of automatons, IT equipment and software, and control and automation services,— the total surface area of the buildings concerned (surface area of floors, including basements),— the name or names of the installing entities proposed for this contract who have carried out works, by specifying those who provided:• electrician services (electrical switchboards, electrical fixtures, automatons, sensors and actuators, cabling);• control and automation services (programming, adjustments and optimisations, operational tests, networks, servers);• effective and compliant commissioning, with attestation of conformity with the manufacturer's specifications.The European Parliament reserves the right to conduct a site visit (with a detailed report) to verify the supporting documents.3. Selection criteria for maintenance:a. Criterion CS-MAINT01 — Possess a maintenance service:i. Definition of the criterion:§1. The candidate shall possess a maintenance service (or after-sales) which has the following characteristics and capacities as a minimum:— operating for at least 3 years from the date of publication of the contract notice,— able to visit the customer on-site, in the Brussels-Capital Region, at the latest by 12 noon the next business day after the first telephone call,— able to work in a working language of the future contract, i.e. French or English,— skilled with the manufacturer's control products and TBM IT systems (automation and supervision),— able to intervene in problems involving both hardware (control, IT) and software (TBM, networks) and cover the 3 levels — 'Management', 'Automation' and 'Site',— comply with the requirements of the manufacturer,— have a trained and experienced FTE staff (full-time time equivalents,1 750 hours/year), including at least 2 engineers and at least 5 senior technicians.§2. Subcontracting of maintenance services is permitted, but only for tasks relating to maintenance levels 1 to 3 in accordance with Standard FDX 60-000:2002.ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-MAINT01][MAINTsvrmaint] The candidate shall communicate the names and particulars of the maintenance entity or entities proposed for the contract. He shall present detailed information about each entity in order to demonstrate full compliance with criterion CS-MAINT01.If maintenance services are subcontracted, the candidate shall indicate the name of the subcontracted maintenance entity, specifying the subcontracted services and responsibilities.b. Criterion CS-MAINT02 — Have already carried out maintenance of control products and TBM systems:i. Definition of the criterion:The candidate shall prove his capacity to carry out the maintenance of control products and TBM IT systems by demonstrating that he has performed 2 maintenance contracts (or orders) in the past.Each reference submitted shall have the following characteristics as a minimum:— the maintenance services lasted at least 1 year and were carried out during the past 3 years from the date of publication of the contract notice,— the maintenance services were carried out in a Member State of the European Union (EU28),— the maintenance services must have involved control products and TBM IT systems covering at least 3 of the 4 following technological fields related to buildings:(a) heating/ventilation/air conditioning/blinds/water and sanitation;(b) electricity distribution/lighting;(c) refrigeration for catering;(d) management of energy and water flows;— the number of points addressed and managed in the installation to be maintained exceeds 40 000 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or 20 000 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— the maintenance services must have involved systematic preventive maintenance operations, with tasks in maintenance level 4 or 5 in accordance with Standard FDX 60-000:2002,— the maintenance services must have been subject to a certificate of satisfactory performance, signed and dated by the customer,— the maintenance services must have amounted to a total annual value of at least 125 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or 62 500 EUR (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— the maintenance services must have been carried out with the on-site presence of control technicians with 3 years of experience (in maintenance customer site): at least 1 FTE (full-time equivalent, 1750 hours/year) (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 0,5 FTE (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-MAINT02]The candidate must provide, for each reference given above, a summary [MAINTreftravn] (with Nos 1 or 2) specifying as a minimum:— the start and end dates of the services,— the place of performance,— the purpose of the services,— the control and TBM products placed, their numbers and the technological fields covered,— the number of points (physical and data, including terminal control),— the maintenance operations carried out,— a list of any potential subcontractors or partners,— the attestations of conformity and satisfactory performance,— the annual value of services (including items and workforce) (excluding taxes),— the number of FTE employees working at the customer's site,— the name of the entity which carried out the maintenance, and the list of possible subcontractors or partners.","accProc":null}
description: The aim of the contract is the signature of a framework contract in order to carry out works with maintenance services in the field of centralised technical management for European Parliament buildings in Brussels.The contractor shall install, program and provide maintenance for a new technical building management system (TBMS) at the European Parliament site in Brussels.Candidates will apply in their capacities as a:— manufacturer,— installer,— maintenance provider.Entities of the candidate with these capacities are hereinafter referred to as 'the manufacturing entity', 'the installing entity' and 'the maintenance entity'.The European Parliament's maintenance services in Brussels want a contractor who is the sole contact and fits the following profile:— is a manufacturer in the field of control and technical building management.The manufacturing capacities are internal and cannot be subcontracted,— is an expert, by way of its products and services, in applications such as heating, ventilation, air conditioning, electricity distribution and lighting,— is able to take responsibility for carrying out the works assignments and maintenance summarised above:• by coordinating with other third parties, internal services or European Parliament contractors who are responsible for maintaining or fitting technical installations related to control and TBM;• by advising the European Parliament's building maintenance services in order to comply with and meet the contractual objectives.It is required to ensure, for the duration of the contract:— the reverse compatibility of all terminal control equipment that has already been installed when new equipment is commissioned,— the homogeneity and uniqueness of the technical building management system, integrating several CTM subsystems and based on BACNet.The contract covers all buildings occupied by the European Parliament in Brussels and is divided into 2 lots. Candidates may tender either for one of the 2 lots (lot 1, lot 2) or for both lots (lot 1 and lot 2).During the course of the contract, the European Parliament reserves the right to withdraw or to add site buildings to either of the 2 lots.

description: The purpose of this procurement procedure is to purchase capacity to support the Agency in the preparation of high-quality scientific services and overall to increase the Agency’s timeliness, anticipatory and responsive capacity. The Agency requires access to supporting specialised expertise in the design, conduct, and reporting of different types of scientific work. Outputs may include reports, digital dashboards, AI based tools, methodological and reporting guidelines, training materials, workshops, databases, collection of literature, etc. The present procurement procedure is aimed at supporting the Agency to rapidly mobilise external expertise in a flexible and efficient manner, ensuring responsiveness to evolving scientific priorities and emerging evidence needs. The activities resulting from this procedure are expected to support the EUDA in monitoring drug markets, use of substances and their consequences. They will also help identify the evidence needed to inform responses in terms of establishing trends, examining emerging threats and tracking developments over time and between settings. Ultimately, this is expected to strengthen the preparedness of the Agency, and of the EU as a whole, to respond to drug-related harms.

description:
The purpose of this procurement procedure is to purchase capacity to support the Agency in
the preparation of high-quality scientific services and overall to increase the Agency’s
timeliness, anticipatory and responsive capacity. The Agency requires access to supporting
specialised expertise in the design, conduct, and reporting of different types of scientific
work. Outputs may include reports, digital dashboards, AI based tools, methodological and
reporting guidelines, training materials, workshops, databases, collection of literature, etc.
The present procurement procedure is aimed at supporting the Agency to rapidly mobilise
external expertise in a flexible and efficient manner, ensuring responsiveness to evolving
scientific priorities and emerging evidence needs.
The activities resulting from this procedure are expected to support the EUDA in monitoring
drug markets, use of substances and their consequences. They will also help identify the
evidence needed to inform responses in terms of establishing trends, examining emerging
threats and tracking developments over time and between settings.
Ultimately, this is expected to strengthen the preparedness of the Agency, and of the EU as a
whole, to respond to drug-related harms.

description: The action aims to continue the ongoing cooperation between the EU and China on policies tackling climate change, in particular on emissions trading, building on the existing cooperation on emissions trading.This action will support the implementation of the annual policy dialogue on emissions trading as agreed in the Memorandum of Understanding on ETS cooperation signed at the China-EU summit in July 2018, including through joint policy research activities designed to provide appropriate and effective solutions to challenges of the Chinese ETS. Furthermore, the action entails important technical knowledge sharing elements to further support China in building up and successfully establishing its nation-wide emission trading system. Specific tasks will include: information and management services, technical assessments and research, organization of specific training activities with a focus on a ‘train-the-trainer approach’.

description: The study will provide energy modelers and policy makers in the EU with detailed data and projections related to the current and future techno-economic performance of cooling technologies, leading to more accurate models and better-informed policy-making in the field of cooling, thereby supporting the heating and cooling strategy. The study will focus on cooling technologies that are applicable for individual and centralized cooling in the residential sector. The study aims to provide impartial quantitative information about the current and future operational and economic characteristics of different cooling technologies. This information will cover key parameters necessary for technical and financial assessments of cooling technologies, as well as for systemic modelling activities, including efficiency, capital, and operating costs. The information provided must be representative of the various conditions prevailing in the EU (e.g., climate, prices). This can be achieved by giving differentiated data according to geographical/climatic zones (e.g., Nordic, Mediterranean, Western, and Eastern) or by other means deemed appropriate, such as formulas, graphs, and/or tables.

description: The Secretariat – composed of a FT Director, Private Sector Dev. Specialist, Admin./ Logistics/driver assistants, and PT Trade and Investment Advisor, ad-hoc experts and IT/Com. expert – will support the SB4U Platform (launched by the President of Uganda in March 2020). The SB4U Platform aims: to structure a PPP dialogue, to improve investment climate (green and sustainable), to steer economic reforms and implementing measures, to strengthen business and trade partnerships between domestic and European companies by producing market information and coordinating missions and events. Actions will: target potential investors to Uganda, create synergies with relevant interventions and policy (with EU Dev. Financing Institutions, with Uganda and EU Member States trade agencies or with existing PPP mechanisms such as the Presidential Investors’ Round Table). The contractor will also be responsible for organising and financing under this contract an Int. Business Forum and other events.

description: Satellite-based navigation and timing services are a cornerstone of Europe’s economy and critical infrastructure resilience. Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) functions, delivered principally by Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) such as the EU owned Galileo, underpin sectors ranging from transport and finance to energy and telecommunications. Several studies attribute roughly 10 % of EU GDP to PNT related activities, while a single day without GNSS could have a financial impact up to €1 billion. The Commission proposal for the European Competitiveness Fund (ECF), includes for the 2028‑2034 Multi‑annual Financial Framework, a contribution to complementary PNT services, which shall increase the resilience in case of disruptions to the services provided by the PNT component (Article 59). The project shall assess how best can the Commission contribute to complementary PNT services in the next MFF. Leveraging existing national and pan‑European infrastructure, the Commission would like to assess: • How to best strengthen with the resilience of PNT services to radio frequency interference (RFI) affecting GNSS services throughout the EU. • How to best contribute to the deployment of a mature, interoperable C T architecture that is ready for operational use within the multi financial framework 2028 2034. • How to best support candidates for a C-PN service, that utilise the C-T infrastructure and are resilient to RFI and to assess whether the technology is ready for deployment or, if not what is required.

description:
Satellite-based navigation and timing services are a cornerstone of Europe’s economy and critical infrastructure resilience. Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) functions, delivered principally by Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) such as the EU owned Galileo, underpin sectors ranging from transport and finance to energy and telecommunications. Several studies attribute roughly 10 % of EU GDP to PNT related activities, while a single day without GNSS could have a financial impact up to €1 billion.
The Commission proposal for the European Competitiveness Fund (ECF), includes for the 2028‑2034 Multi‑annual Financial Framework, a contribution to complementary PNT services, which shall increase the resilience in case of disruptions to the services provided by the PNT component (Article 59).
The project shall assess how best can the Commission contribute to complementary PNT services in the next MFF.
Leveraging existing national and pan‑European infrastructure, the Commission would like to assess:
•	How to best strengthen with the resilience of PNT services to radio frequency interference (RFI) affecting GNSS services throughout the EU.
•	How to best contribute to the deployment of a mature, interoperable C T architecture that is ready for operational use within the multi financial framework 2028 2034.
•	How to best support candidates for a C-PN service, that utilise the C-T infrastructure and are resilient to RFI and to assess whether the technology is ready for deployment or, if not what is required.

description: The purpose of this contract is to improve the sustainability and efficiency of social and health care systems for the elderly with a focus on quality home care and day care services. To this aim, an elderly care model will be developed and various sub-activities such as swot analysis, desk studies, focus groups meetings, etc. will be conducted for design of the model. Also, pilot implementation of the model will be carried out. Apart from these, training modules will be prepared and trainings will be delivered to training of trainers and service providers working in elderly care services. Besides, awareness raising activities will be organised; studies will be conducted and other activities such as organising summit on elderly policies, gathering local steering committees will be arranged.

description: La Agencia Europea para la Seguridad y la Salud en el Trabajo (EU-OSHA) tiene previsto lanzar una licitación con los siguientes entregables y objetivos: Entregables previstos: • La contratación del suministro de equipos de seguridad relacionados con sistemas de detección de incendios e intrusión, incluyendo los servicios de instalación y puesta en marcha; • La prestación de servicios de mantenimiento de dichos equipos (incendio/intrusión), tanto de los existentes como de los recientemente adquiridos. Objetivos generales del contrato a adjudicar: • Mejorar el sistema de seguridad en su conjunto; y, en consecuencia, • Proporcionar condiciones de seguridad óptimas para las personas, los bienes y la información en las instalaciones de la autoridad contratante. Se prevé una visita a las instalaciones como parte del procedimiento. Se proporcionarán más detalles en el Pliego de Condiciones de la licitación. El presupuesto máximo total disponible para el contrato a adjudicar será de 60.000,00 EUR, excluido el IVA. Es posible expresar interés como organización individual o como consorcio. No obstante, tenga en cuenta que los candidatos invitados sólo podrán presentar una oferta conjunta con otros operadores económicos si han expresado interés en el procedimiento previsto como consorcio.

description: Le processus de décentralisation est avancé en république du Congo, mais très faible au niveau des structures communales. L'objectif général du projet, dont ce marché fait partie, est d'améliorer les conditions de vie et l'attractivité des villes de Nkayi et Owando. L'assainissement a été choisi comme domaine d'application du renforcement de capacités des autorités locales.La convention de financement comporte trois objectifs spécifiques:— le 1er, objet du présent marché, est le renforcement des collectivités locales;— le 2nd relève des travaux d'assainissement. (objet d'une convention avec l'AFD et d'un contrat de subvention avec une OSC);— le 3e, objet du présent marché et de la subvention à l’OSC, est l'amélioration de la gouvernance locale sensible au genre et à la participation des communautés, notamment des femmes.Ces trois objectifs avec ces trois modalités de mise en œuvre, forment un unique projet nécessitant une coordination des différents acteurs.

description: The objective of the contract is to provide services to support the Energy Efficient transformation of existing public buildings conducted by the General Directorate of Construction Affairs to achieve the 2053 targets for Carbon Neutral Türkiye. In this context, the energy consumption of existing public buildings will be evaluated, and innovative solutions to improve energy performance will be searched. Using dedicated software, an energy passport system will be developed to increase the energy performance of public buildings. Within the scope of this contract, which aims to support the energy efficiency sector and to use financial mechanisms effectively, consultancy services will be provided to create a sustainable model for increasing the energy performance of existing public buildings with the cooperation of relevant stakeholders.

description: JRC.C.1 developed EU harmonised testing procedures and protocols for LTWE cells, stacks and systems targeting energy storage applications. Before these documents can indeed be widely used by research organisations, developers and system integrators, for example, to assess progress of a particular product (i.e. stack prototype) or technology, they need to undergo independent experimental validation preferably at stack in the kW scale. Currently, JRC.C.1 has capability to perform electrolysis testing on single cells only using an existent 500 W dual purpose fuel cell and electrolysis test station. Beside utilisation in test campaigns to verify progress in EU projects and technologies, the investment in a new electrolysis test station also provides testing capacity to future water electrolysis projects in Horizon Europe and for the ongoing open access to JRC research infrastructures initiative.

description: The overall objective of this project is to reduce depletion of natural resources used in production processes and amount of waste generated by promoting usage of secondary raw materials and enhancing market for high quality recyclables. In order to contribute to the sustainable development, the contract will include technical assistance and institutional capacity building activities for identification and effective implementation of end-of-waste criteria for specific waste streams. Mainly, current situation in Turkey will be assessed by means of demanding sectors of waste streams such as metal, scrap, glass cullet, copper scrap, waste paper, biodegradable waste, waste plastic, textile waste etc. Besides, draft technical regulations on establishing criteria determining when certain types of materials cease to be waste, will be prepared compatible with Turkish context. Also guiding documents as draft regulations, roadmap and guidelines will be composed as the national strategy.

description: A contract for research services to design, prototype and evaluate data pipelines for collecting, structuring, validating and monitoring evidence from heterogeneous public data sources. The pipelines should combine deterministic data engineering (API and database extraction, parsing), machine learning, and large language models (LLMs) with human expert validation. The contract will be structured in two broad packages. Work-package 1 supports INCITE (https://innovation-centre-for-industrial-transformation.ec.europa.eu). It shall develop a pilot to identify and update project-level information on emerging and established techniques for decarbonisation, depollution, resource efficiency and circular economy in industrial and livestock installations, covering technology, maturity, financing, performance and dependencies. Work-package 2 shall develop and tests methods to build and maintain a facility-level dataset of circular-economy installations in EU Member States. This covers facilities that recover, sort, process or recycle waste and by-products into secondary materials, including their location, capacities, technologies, ownership, inputs, outputs and commercial links. Both work-packages are exploratory pilots: the aim is to demonstrate and rigorously evaluate workflows, not to deliver a production platform. The contractor must deliver documented prototype pipelines, validated datasets, a quantitative evaluation of accuracy, coverage and cost, and a feasibility assessment for continuous updates and scale-up. In terms of the technical approach, the contractor is expected to propose a hybrid architecture, choosing the most appropriate technique for each task and justifying it on accuracy, cost, reproducibility and maintainability. For example: • Structured sources (e.g. EU funding databases such as CORDIS, Innovation Fund and LIFE; the EU Industrial Emissions Portal; national permit registries; Eurostat) can be accessed deterministically via APIs, bulk downloads or database extraction wherever possible. • Machine learning and rule-based methods can be used for classification, deduplication, geocoding and entity resolution across sources. • LLMs can be used mainly to extract structured information from unstructured documents (permits, company websites, press releases, scientific publications, sustainability and financial reports). Agent-based workflows can be used in cases where multi-step search is necessary.

description: Le Parlement européen lance régulièrement des procédures de passation de marchés publics en vue d’obtenir l’assistance juridique d’un cabinet d’avocats exerçant dans une juridiction spécifique et dans un domaine spécifique du droit. Ces procédures sont régies par les dispositions du règlement (UE, Euratom) 2024/2509 du Parlement européen et du Conseil du 23 septembre 2024 relatif aux règles financières applicables au budget général de l’Union (ci-après: le «RF»). Afin d’identifier les cabinets d’avocats présents sur le marché susceptibles d’être intéressés à représenter le Parlement européen devant les juridictions françaises et à fournir une assistance juridique dans les affaires non contentieuses relevant du droit français, le Service juridique du Parlement européen lance un appel à manifestation d’intérêt conformément au point 13.1 b) de l’annexe I du RF.

description: Im Rahmen dieser Ausschreibung sucht die Kommission einen Auftragnehmer, der sie bei der Pressearbeit in Deutschland unterstützt. Im Sinne der Effizienz hat die Ausschreibung das Ziel, folgende Dienstleistungen auf einen Vertragspartner zu übertragen. Konkret soll der Auftragnehmer unsere Arbeit unterstützen durch: - die Organisation einer großen Pressereise pro Jahr für bis zu 35 Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer in einen anderen EU-Mitgliedstaat oder ein Beitrittskandidatenland; - die Organisation von bis zu zehn Reisen für Medienvertreter/innen und Stakeholder pro Jahr für bis zu 25 Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer nach Brüssel; - die Unterstützung unserer jährlichen Zusammenarbeit mit Kooperationspartnern wie der Jugendpresse e.V. und dem WDR Europaforum; - die Akquise und Verwaltung von Tools für unsere Pressearbeit.

description: The subject of this call for tenders is the provision of consecutive interpretation services for the 2026 edition of the “EU Comes to Your School” initiative, organised by the Delegation of the European Union to Japan in cooperation with the diplomatic missions of EU Member States. The contractor will be required to provide suitably qualified interpreters for up to 22 high school visits taking place on 12–13 November 2026 at different locations across Japan, covering the English-Japanese language combination in both directions (EN↔JA). The interpreters will facilitate communication between EU and Member State Ambassadors and diplomats and the participating schools and students during presentations, discussions and exchanges. Each school visit is expected to last up to three hours, including a brief meeting with the school principal/teachers, the presentation, Q&A session and other related activities. Most speakers will be fluent but non-native English speakers; interpretation will ensure clear and effective communication throughout the visit. The interpreters shall be professionally trained and capable of providing accurate, fluent and reliable interpretation for a large public audience. The contractor shall maintain close coordination with the Delegation and shall liaise directly with each Member State Embassy in Tokyo to ensure the necessary logistical arrangements are in place for the day of the event. The contractor will also be responsible for making all necessary travel arrangements for the interpreters and for covering all related travel, accommodation (if needed) and subsistence costs.

description: Ce marché d’assistance technique est lancé dans le cadre du Programme « Soutien aux Chaînes de Valeur Forêt pour une Transition Verte au Gabon » (ACT-61979) pour une durée de 48 mois. Il porte sur la coordination et le soutien des initiatives de l'Union européenne au Gabon dans le secteur de la Transition Verte, et plus particulièrement dans le secteur « forêt/boisenvironnement ». Les activités comprennent en particulier l'appui au pilotage du Partenariat Forêt UE/Gabon et le soutien au développement des chaines de valeur « forêt / bois » incluant l’accompagnement de processus portant sur l’amélioration du cadre économique, juridique et technique, ainsi que sur l'accès aux financements innovants et aux investissements. Les activités pourront couvrir la réalisation d’études spécifiques, le renforcement des capacités, l'organisation d'événements, et la collaboration avec d’autres initiatives de l'UE.

description: The European Parliament is seeking to establish a list of experts to provide independent external expertise to its Directorate-General for Security and Safety (DG SAFE). This expertise would relate to issues within DG SAFE’s scope of interests and responsibilities. The list of experts will be set up under Article 242 of the EU Financial Regulation. This list will be valid for five years from the date of its publication and may be used throughout this period, whenever Parliament deems it appropriate. This call is exclusively addressed to experts with scientific, academic, operational and research experience in security and safety issues, as specified in paragraph 3.2. Furthermore, the call is exclusively addressed to natural persons, that is to say, to individuals with official residence in the EU, or who have official residence in a non-EU country that has concluded a specific public procurement agreement with the EU, giving official residents of that country access to this type of contract.

description:
The European Parliament is seeking to establish a list of experts to provide independent external expertise to its Directorate-General for Security and Safety (DG SAFE). This expertise would relate to issues within DG SAFE’s scope of interests and responsibilities. 
The list of experts will be set up under Article 242 of the EU Financial Regulation. This list will be valid for five years from the date of its publication and may be used throughout this period, whenever Parliament deems it appropriate. This call is exclusively addressed to experts with scientific, academic, operational and research experience in security and safety issues, as specified in paragraph 3.2. Furthermore, the call is exclusively addressed to natural persons, that is to say, to individuals with official residence in the EU, or who have official residence in a non-EU country that has concluded a specific public procurement agreement with the EU, giving official residents of that country access to this type of contract.

description: Supply and distribution of recycled paper in DIN A4 format to the European Parliament’s delivery sites in Brussels, Luxembourg and Strasbourg. The technical characteristics and environmental requirements applicable to the paper, the evidence to be submitted with the tender, the tender-stage compatibility and runnability testing, and the tender requirements relating to the computerised order management system are set out in Annex I to Tender Specifications. The detailed terms and conditions governing the implementation of the Framework Contract, including the computerised order management system, ordering and pricing arrangements, delivery conditions, certificate of acceptance, non-conformities, paper compatibility during contract performance and carbon offsetting, are set out in the Framework Contract and its annexes. This contract also includes: — the provision and updating of a computerised management system (placing of orders, monitoring of the budget line, electronic invoicing, statistics, etc.) in accordance with the European Parliament’s instructions; — training of authorised staff (approximately 400 persons) in the electronic ordering system or any other system; These authorised staff are henceforth referred to as ‘managing departments’ (departments managing ‘user’ contracts (requesting departments) or ‘printshop’ contracts (where reference is made only to the latter); — annual offsetting of the CO2 generated by the production and transport (waste-warehouse-client chain) of the paper ordered.

description: One of the actions derived from the Farm to Fork Strategy and the “Vision for Agriculture and Food - Shaping together an attractive farming and agri-food sector for future generations” is to facilitate access to market of biocontrol active substances used in plant protection products, such as micro-organisms used as active substances. Human exposure to micro-organisms may lead to sensitising reactions. However, no validated method to assess the sensitising potential of micro-organisms exists, leading to precautionary approaches such as default warning labelling of plant protection products containing micro-organisms and obligations to use personal protective equipment when applying such plant protection products. Providing more scientific clarity on how sensitising potential could be better characterised and predicted would result in streamlining risk assessment and regulatory processes, and eventually in a more tailored approaches on labelling and recommendations. The study envisages a review on epidemiological data on sensitising effects caused by micro-organisms in areas where humans might be exposed to micro-organisms, such as occupational areas that might involve manufacturing of micro-organisms such as for food, feed, pharmaceutical purposes. This study may lead to identify patterns in micro-organisms groups which caused sensitising reactions, which would support further activities such as validating methods to assess sensitising potential of micro-organisms.

description: The main objective of this project is to strengthen institutional capacity of Ministry of Health on cancer screening and registration. The main outputs of this project are as follows: • Cancer registration centres are upgraded and accredited nationally and internationally. • Cancer screening centres and mobile cancer screening capacity are improved. For this purpose, several activities will be carried out: The number of accredited centres will be increased. Data analysis will be carried out in order to use the data of cancer registries in various calculations such as survival, mortality and regional differences. Furthermore, trainings will be given to health staff in the cancer registration centres and a report on cost efficiency assessment in the field of cancer based on international standard will be prepared. In addition, cancer screening services will be increased and expanded throughout the country by increasing the number of mobile cancer screening vehicles in the field. The mobile screening service will prioritise the participation of rural and disadvantaged groups. Information and communication activities will also be conducted towards advancing health literacy of individuals.

description: This contract concerns the procurement of 5,318 laptops intended for use in public high schools across Albania. The objective is to ensure inclusive access to digital tools for educators, contributing to improved learning outcomes and digital literacy. The scope includes the supply, delivery, distribution to designated location, unloading, on-site installation, functional testing, and commercial warranty coverage for three years. The contractor will also be responsible for packaging and logistics. The equipment must meet the energy efficiency and performance standards defined in the technical specifications. The contract is funded under the IPA III Operational Programme 2024–2027 and aligns with Albania’s digital education priorities.

description: The JRC is considering a framework contract with the objective to provide services to cover the conceptualisation, preparation and implementation of citizen participation and deliberation activities, including deliberative formats, led by, and in close collaboration with, the European Commission. This includes geographical scales from local through to multi-country activities. At the same time, the objective of this Prior Information Notice (PIN) is to collect information from the market on a prospective call for tenders. The JRC is asking interested service providers, and particularly those with considerable relevant expertise and practical experience in the field, to respond to the following anonymous survey https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/FWC_CitizenEngagementEU before 17 September 2021. All submitted data will be treated with strict confidentiality. Replies by other means will not be considered.

The contractor shall place appropriate locked recipients (with or without bags) in order to enable easy, secure and rapid removal of the contents of the recipients in due time. A security clearance is required for all actors involved in the service.

description: FPI.6 is responsible for concluding centralized framework contracts (FWCs), for the coverage of needs of CFSP bodies and persons (CSDP Civilian Operations, EU Special Representatives, KSC) in a variety of supplies and services. In light of this, FPI.6 intends to launch an open procedure, with the aim of concluding a 4-year single framework contract, for the supply of IT hardware equipment to CFSP bodies and persons through specific contracts/orders that they will be able to place under the FWC. The place of performance is the current places where CFSP bodies and persons are (Belgium, Ukraine, Moldova, Kosovo*, Armenia, Georgia, Iraq, Israel, occupied Palestinian territories, Somalia, Libya, Mali, Central African Republic, Ghana, Togo, Benin, Ivory Coast) and any other place worldwide where possible future CFSP bodies and persons might be established in the future.

FPI.6 is responsible for concluding centralized framework contracts (FWCs), for the coverage of needs of CFSP bodies and persons (CSDP Civilian Operations, EU Special Representatives, KSC) in a variety of supplies and services. 

In light of this, FPI.6 intends to launch an open procedure, with the aim of concluding a 4-year single framework contract, for the supply of IT hardware equipment to CFSP bodies and persons through specific contracts/orders that they will be able to place under the FWC.

The place of performance is the current places where CFSP bodies and persons are (Belgium, Ukraine, Moldova, Kosovo*, Armenia, Georgia, Iraq, Israel, occupied Palestinian territories, Somalia, Libya, Mali, Central African Republic, Ghana, Togo, Benin, Ivory Coast) and any other place worldwide where possible future CFSP bodies and persons might be established in the future.

description: The main objective of the contract is to increase the competitiveness of the TR82 Region through supporting SMEs active in seafood/fishery and tourism sectors in the Region, by improving production and market conditions and connections with new and existing markets. The TA services will be provided under group of three main activities namely, i) Operationalization of Fish Processing and Storage Centre, ii) Operationalization of SME Support Centre and iii) Competitiveness Study for Tourism sector. For achieving these objectives, the technical assistance services will be focused on diagnostic studies and business consultancy and development services provided to the Tourism and Fishery SME Support Centre (SSC) and seafood/fishery and tourism SMEs of the region, as well as preparation of tourism master plan, cluster analysis, tourism strategy document and windows projects for the Region.

description: Dans le but d'améliorer la gestion durable de ses ressources forestières, la République du Congo s'est engagée en 2008 dans la négociation d'un Accord de Partenariat Volontaire (APV) pour l’application des règlementations forestières, la gouvernance et les échanges commerciaux (FLEGT en acronyme anglais pour Forest Law Enforcement, Governance and Trade) avec l'Union européenne. L'accord est entré officiellement en vigueur le 1er mars 2013. Le système de vérification de la légalité (SVL) de l'APV de la République du Congo est composé de six éléments dont un audit indépendant. Depuis 2015, un Auditeur Indépendant du Système (AIS) est présent en République du Congo dans le but de s'assurer de la performance et de l'efficience du système de vérification de la légalité en cours de mise en œuvre. Le précédent contrat étant arrivé à échéance en 2019, le présent marché vise à mobiliser un nouvel auditeur indépendant.

description: The European Parliament regularly launches public procurement procedures with a view to obtaining legal assistance from a law firm practicing in a specific jurisdiction and in a specific area of law. In order to identify law firms on the market that may be interested in representing the European Parliament before Maltese courts and providing legal assistance in non-contentious cases under Maltese law, the Legal Service of the European Parliament is launching a call for expressions of interest in accordance with point 13.1(b) of Annex I to the FR.

description: Frontex Surveillance Aircraft Services with land/coastline range fixed wing aircraft - the services which the Contractor shall provide under this FWC will be based on mission flights where the asset, following Frontex instructions, surveys the Area of Interest included in the Service Deployment Area, searching for ‘objects of interest’ mandated by Frontex Regulation, and passing surveillance data and information to the Operational Coordination Centre designated by Frontex. Aircraft shall be able: - to reach the Area of Interest (surveillance area) located at a distance of minimum 100NM from the Base Airport, and; - to stay minimum 1 hour in the Area of Interest with the average speed as of 90 knots, between 1000 feet and 5000 feet and return back to the base airport, and; - to perform a total minimum of 4 hours of flight (excluding final reserve and contingency fuel) with 1 Frontex liaison officer on board in line with the 2 requirements above with the minimum mandatory Payload stipulated in the Tender Dossier.

description: The European Union's engagement with partner countries has gained renewed strategic importance in response to the evolving geopolitical environment and the renewed momentum of the enlargement process. The programme covers partner countries at different stages of their relationship with the European Union, requiring communication approaches that reflect their respective political contexts, policy priorities and communication needs. Communication challenges differ by the fact that public awareness of the European Union's support remains uneven across the region. While the European Union is the largest donor, investor and trading partner for most partner countries, public understanding of the scale and impact of EU support, as well as of the accession process itself, remains limited. Recent perception surveys carried out under the regional communication programmes show that many citizens are insufficiently informed about the European Union's policies, financial assistance and priorities. Against this background, strategic communication has become an integral part of the European Union's engagement with partner countries. Previous regional communication programmes have successfully increased the visibility of the European Union, developed valuable communication tools and established networks of partners and multipliers across the region. The future programme will continue this effort and adopt a more strategic and service-oriented approach in supporting DG ENEST and EU Delegations communicating the European Union's priorities across partner countries. The programme will provide communication campaigns and products, strengthen engagement with key multipliers, improve the visibility of EU support, generate communication intelligence and audience insights, and offer flexible communication services that can be mobilised in response to operational needs. This approach will ensure greater coherence across partner countries while allowing communication activities to be adapted to national contexts and emerging geopolitical developments.

description: The JRC's European Reference Laboratory for Air Pollution is mandated by the Air Quality Directive 2024/2881 to carry out quality assurance programmes with the Member States air Quality laboratories. Particle Number Counting (PNC) and Particle Number Size Distribution (PNSD) are two of the new air pollutants introduced by the Directive. In this frame a prior assessment and a further reference implementation for such variables requires to buy a Scanning Mobility Particle Sizer and an additional Condensation Particle Counter. description: Le marché «EU-Algeria 4 Business: mise en œuvre d'activités de dialogue économique, de facilitation du commerce et de l'investissement en Algérie » soutiendra des activités de coopération économique entre l'Union européenne et l'Algérie. Il couvrira l'organisation de dialogues sectoriels sur l'investissement, d'ateliers de facilitation du commerce et des investissements, la réalisation d'études ciblées et de diagnostics et la tenue d'événements pour soutenir les investissements européens sur le marché algérien. Le recours à ce marché se justifie par la nécessité de mobiliser une expertise spécialisée pour appuyer le dialogue public-privé, identifier les obstacles et opportunités, améliorer l'environnement des affaires et l'accès aux financements, et favoriser les partenariats économiques et les investissements euro-algériens.

description: The Contract will contribute to further systematic reform of the national social welfare, child-care and health systems, through construction of a new facility for two clinics (Clinic for Infectious Diseases and Clinic for Dermatovenerology). In this regard the Contract will consist of all activities needed to conduct the subsequent supervision services during the entire implementation period of the respective works contract until issuing the Final Acceptance Certificate and Final statement of account. In this context the successful Contractor will provide supervision services assuming the role of the Engineer for the supervision of the above-mentioned works contract, in accordance with FIDIC Red Book (Second Edition 2017). The supervision of the works contracts will be delivered in accordance with the Montenegrin construction legislation and EU standards.

description: The aim of this project is to equip DG TRADE leadership with the long-term insights needed to navigate the future of EU trade. By generating policy-relevant strategic foresight, it will directly inform and strengthen the steering of trade and economic security policy. The project will be delivered through two primary outputs: • A series of concise, high-level papers (4-6 pages each) written by leading external experts on a range of specified topics. • A one-day strategic foresight seminar held in person, providing a platform for genuine debate between the expert authors and DG Trade senior management, under Chatham House rules. The successful contractor will be responsible for the end-to-end management and organisation of both the commissioning of papers and the execution of the seminar.

description: El objeto de la presente invitación a licitar es la prestación de los servicios de limpieza y desinfección, gestión de residuos y control de plagas. Las prestaciones se clasifican de la siguiente manera: - limpieza y desinfección de los edificios (continente y contenido), - gestión de residuos, incluyendo transporte y tratamiento de los mismos, - control de plagas, - servicios bajo demanda, - compra y alquiler de material relacionado con las prestaciones. description: The purpose of this public contract concerns the design and construction of FRONTEX permanent premises also referred to as FRONTEX headquarters (HQ). The Republic of Poland transferred to FRONTEX the ownership of a plot of land in Warsaw for the Agency to plan and construct its headquarters building(s) in accordance with the Polish building law and regulations. Frontex wishes to establish a project promoting the highest standards in sustainable building methodologies. Initial estimation is a building of 70 000 m2 for an average of 2 000 staff members.

description: The campaign addresses the Country Communication Strategy priority of strengthening trust that the European Union stands with people in Latvia’s Eastern Border Region and supports its security, resilience and long-term development. Latgale forms part of the external border of both the EU and NATO and faces heightened geopolitical uncertainty alongside demographic and socioeconomic challenges that affect people’s ability and willingness to live, work, invest and plan their future in the region. Significant EU-supported investment and action are already contributing to security, infrastructure, entrepreneurship, employment, education, healthcare and community development in Latgale. At the same time, attitudes towards the EU in the region are less positive than nationally. In June 2026, 35% of respondents in Latgale considered Latvia’s EU membership a good thing, compared with 49% nationally, while 46% described it as neither good nor bad. These findings underline the need for communication that is locally relevant, credible and connected to people’s everyday priorities and ambitions. The campaign will address uncertainty about the opportunities available in Latgale and whether they can lead to a secure and sustainable future. It will connect people’s ambitions with practical opportunities and next steps, while demonstrating the EU’s role as a reliable long-term partner that helps people, businesses and communities turn ambitions into action. In parallel, it will strengthen recognition across Latvia of Latgale as a capable, culturally distinctive and strategically important part of Latvia and the European Union. This matters because perceptions beyond the region shape the wider environment for tourism, cooperation, investment, relocation and return, and therefore influence Latgale’s opportunities for long-term development. Planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation. Fine-tuning of campaign’s strategy and tactics, selection of human-interest stories of EU opportunities, messaging according to the audience sub-segments and events and actions, stakeholder relations with 9 municipalities. Development of all campaign assets and content, event concept and content, media planning, media partnerships and cooperation, baseline study and post-evaluation, reporting

description: The JRC Geel requires boxes for the distribution of its reference materials with dry ice. The boxes are single-use. These boxes must be able to hold sufficient dry ice and be sufficiently insulated to keep small products (typically < 300 mL; no thermal mass) at temperatures below -5 °C for at least 48 hours and another type for 96 hours. Both kind of boxes must be qualified for the air transport of dry ice (IATA PI 954). The expected demand per year is as follows: - 300 Boxes for shipments of up to 48 h. - 150 boxes for shipments of up to 96 h. These quantities are approximate and are not binding.

description: In the context of the Republic of Albania’s preparations for accession to the European Union, technical assistance is necessary to support beneficiary institutions in meeting the requirements of Chapter 22 and preparing for the effective management of EU Cohesion Policy after accession. This technical assistance will support the relevant Albanian Authorities. The assistance will focus on the timely fulfillment of the Chapter 22 Closing Benchmarks while also supporting, through a strategically forward-looking approach, the implementation of other measures set out in the Chapter 22 Action Plan. It will include measures aimed at strengthening the institutional, administrative, and strategic capacities required for the future management and implementation of EU Cohesion Policy.

description: The EEA management recognises the increasing complexity of work and the continuous change in working lives of its staff. The EEA is committed to foster staff wellbeing, which is based on the dynamic concept of wellbeing at work, covering a more rounded approach from social wellbeing to physical, mental health and wellbeing at all levels of the organisation (individual, unit/department, management and organisational level). The objective is to provide staff members with timely and easy access to psycho-sociological support, to promote personal growth and development and to make healthier lifestyle choices with a goal to maintain and build a resilient workforce.

description: The purpose of the present tender is to develop, operate and maintain an IT solution providing real-time information on crossing time at the main border crossing points (BCPs) for road cargo vehicles, helping to support the fundamental principle of free movement of goods in the EU, and allowing the Commission to monitor BCP performance as a crisis management tool in the event of traffic disruption (blockades, temporary border controls, environmental disasters, etc.). The tenderer, either alone or in consortia, must prove experience in the field of development, operation and maintenance of software and IT platforms as well as experience in the field of fleet management and/or analytics of on-board vehicle telematics data. The tenderer must prove to have at its disposal the following evidence: At least two similar (in scope and complexity) projects completed in the last five years preceding the deadline for submission of tenders, with a minimum value for each of them of € 100 000 and at least one project completed in the last five years preceding the deadline for submission of tenders, involving fleet management and/or analytics of on-board vehicle telematics data. Please note that this is not a call for tenders but a publication announcing the Contracting authority's intention to publish a future middle value procedure.

description: The objective of this contract is to analyse innovation capabilities and industrial dynamics in European rural areas using econometric, machine learning, and economic complexity methods. The analyses shall address two issues of EU policy-relevance: (i) The demand for innovation skills in EU rural areas compared to non-rural (i.e., intermediate and urban) areas, and their relationship with regional industrial dynamics. (ii) The evolution of workers', firms', and other territorial capabilities to estimate development pathways and growth potential in EU rural areas compared to non-rural areas.

description: De bestaande stalen bekledingspanelen van de technische vloer van gebouw 312 hebben een vergevorderd stadium van corrosie bereikt als gevolg van langdurige blootstelling aan de zeer agressieve kustomgeving. De combinatie van zoute lucht, hoge vochtigheid en door wind aangedreven vocht heeft de materiaaldegradatie aanzienlijk versneld. Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt brengt progressieve corrosie de structurele integriteit en bevestigingssystemen van de panelen in gevaar, waardoor het risico op losraken, vallende elementen en binnendringing van water in de interne componenten toeneemt. Vanuit functioneel oogpunt vermindert de verslechtering het vermogen van de bouwschil om adequate weersbescherming te bieden, wat kan leiden tot verdere schade aan isolatie, onderbouw en interne installaties. Vanuit esthetisch en institutioneel oogpunt heeft de zichtbaar aangetaste gevel een negatieve invloed op het algemene uiterlijk van de faciliteit, wat niet strookt met de normen die worden verwacht van een goed onderhouden, langlopend publiek goed. De voorgestelde vervanging is daarom een noodzakelijke maatregel om de veiligheid te herstellen, de duurzaamheid op lange termijn in een categorie van corrosieve blootstelling aan de kust te waarborgen en de functionele en visuele integriteit van het gebouw te behouden.

Furthermore, they can't integrate with the new JRC DELTA domain. The specifications for these new PCs have been thoroughly reviewed and agreed upon with the T6 unit, as they will be placed in the DELTA domain.
