description:
The European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA) plans to launch a call for tender for the provision of a mapping of European Union (EU) data sources on occupational exposure to cancer risk factors and a comparison with the Workers’ exposure survey (WES) data.  

Overall objectives 
1. To identify and describe data sources on EU occupational exposure to cancer risk factors (CRF) and the information included in each of them (e.g. CRF coverage, population coverage, variables, contextual exposure information, language, reference date of the data, country, sector coverage, format, accessibility, ownership). 

2. To assess, for each of the six WES countries (Germany, Ireland, Spain, France, Hungary and Finland) and for the 24 cancer risk factors covered by WES, the feasibility of comparing WES exposure data with data available in the other data sources identified under objective 1. The assessment should consider factors collected under objective 1, such as CRF coverage, population coverage, variables, contextual exposure information, language, reference date of the data, country, sector coverage, format, accessibility, ownership, and should determine and justify whether a meaningful comparison is (or not) possible, describing in detail the limitations in terms of population, CRF, level of detail, methodology, but also relevance, quality, and accessibility. 

3. To compare, for each WES country and each cancer risk factor, the exposure data available in WES with the corresponding data from the EU data sources identified under objective 2, where deemed feasible. 

Deliverables will include, at least: 

- an inception report. 
- a template for identifying the information available in each data source that is needed for the descriptive inventory. 
- an interim version of a descriptive inventory of all data sources in the six WES countries relating to occupational exposure to cancer risk factors. 
- a complete descriptive inventory of all data sources in all the EU member states relating to occupational exposure to cancer risk factors. 
- a report, that must include: 
. an assessment, for each of the six WES countries and CRF, of the feasibility of comparing WES exposure data with data available from EU data sources.  
. the justification of whether a meaningful comparison is (or not) possible, namely by identifying the limitations, the similarities and differences, as well as the expected relevance and quality of the results. 
- a report, that must include: 
. a comparison, for each WES country and CRF, of the exposure data available in WES and the corresponding data from other data sources.  
. a critical analysis of the comparison, highlighting key similarities, differences, and discrepancies, and presenting clear conclusions and findings arising from the comparison, in particular in terms of relevance and quality.  
. a short summary of the main findings and conclusions for each country, cancer risk factor and data source. 
. a stand-alone executive summary, providing an overview of the main findings for each report. 
. PowerPoint presentations (or similar) with the key findings of each report. 

Publication of this ex-ante publicity notice does not constitute a commitment by EU-OSHA to launch the procurement procedure. 
The maximum total budget available for the contract to be awarded is EUR 135,000 (excluding VAT). 
It is possible to express interest as an individual organisation or a consortium. However please note that invited candidates can submit a joint tender with other economic operators only if they have expressed interest in the planned procedure as a consortium. 
More information regarding the participation rules and the subject matter for this contract can be found here:
https://osha.europa.eu/en/about-eu-osha/procurement/call-tender/osha2026mvp0034-exa-mapping-eu-data-sources-occupational-exposure-cancer-risk-factors-and-comparison-workers-exposure-survey-wes-data-middle-value-procedure

description: The overall objective of this tender is to procure a Framework Contract to strengthen the capacity for genomic epidemiology and public health bioinformatics through interdisciplinary trainings, which is crucial for response during a pandemic or unexpected major public health events. The general objectives of the trainings are to support countries in building up their capacity in genomic epidemiology and bioinformatics for public health purposes, and to increase the interdisciplinary collaboration between bioinformaticians, epidemiologists and microbiologists within a country to facilitate the routine use of genomic information for surveillance, preparedness, and outbreak response. Activities shall also enhance data sharing and collaborations between public health institutions and ECDC, and enhanced networking activities will foster cross-border collaborations. The target groups for the trainings are professionals working in public health institutions with a background in computational biology and bioinformatics; and professionals working in public health institutions who do not have a specific background in bioinformatics. The aims of the trainings are: * To allow the professionals with a background in computational biology and bioinformatics to: - enhance and extend their skills in order to strengthen their capacity in the field of public health bioinformatics; - better understand the needs and concepts of epidemiology and public health microbiology, with a focus on the inputs and outputs needed by their counterparts (i.e. microbiologists, epidemiologists, professionals in public health surveillance and response) to take rapid and informed public health action. * To allow the professionals without a background in computational biology/bioinformatics to: - gain a better understanding of how genomic epidemiology can be applied in a public health context with special focus on how traditional and genomic data can be jointly analysed, interpreted and used for public health purposes; - become more familiar with the concepts, formats and conventions commonly used in microbial genomics, and get a better understanding of how the structure and format of the data can be used to streamline the data analysis process; - better understand the concepts behind and use of the most common bioinformatic tools and pipelines used for epidemiological analyses, including limitations and possible alternatives; and - gain a better overview of the basic principles, options for and best practices of data storage, management and sharing, with a specific focus on sequencing data and associated metadata.

description:
The overall objective of this tender is to procure a Framework Contract to strengthen the capacity for genomic epidemiology and public health bioinformatics through interdisciplinary trainings, which is crucial for response during a pandemic or unexpected major public health events. 

The general objectives of the trainings are to support countries in building up their capacity in genomic epidemiology and bioinformatics for public health purposes, and to increase the interdisciplinary collaboration between bioinformaticians, epidemiologists and microbiologists within a country to facilitate the routine use of genomic information for surveillance, preparedness, and outbreak response. Activities shall also enhance data sharing and collaborations between public health institutions and ECDC, and enhanced networking activities will foster cross-border collaborations.   

The target groups for the trainings are professionals working in public health institutions with a background in computational biology and bioinformatics; and professionals working in public health institutions who do not have a specific background in bioinformatics.

The aims of the trainings are:
* To allow the professionals with a background in computational biology and bioinformatics to:
   -  enhance and extend their skills in order to strengthen their capacity in the field of public health bioinformatics; 
   - better understand the needs and concepts of epidemiology and public health microbiology, with a focus on the inputs and outputs needed by their counterparts (i.e. microbiologists, epidemiologists, professionals in public health surveillance and response) to take rapid and informed public health action. 
* To allow the professionals without a background in computational biology/bioinformatics to:
   - gain a better understanding of how genomic epidemiology can be applied in a public health context with special focus on how traditional and genomic data can be jointly analysed, interpreted and used for public health purposes;
   - become more familiar with the concepts, formats and conventions commonly used in microbial genomics, and get a better understanding of how the structure and format of the data can be used to streamline the data analysis process; 
   - better understand the concepts behind and use of the most common bioinformatic tools and pipelines used for epidemiological analyses, including limitations and possible alternatives; and
   - gain a better overview of the basic principles, options for and best practices of data storage, management and sharing, with a specific focus on sequencing data and associated metadata.

description: Euroopa päeva kontserdi ja festivaliala korraldamine Narvas 9. mail 2027 Keskmise maksumusega hankemenetlus Käesoleva hanke eesmärk on leida pakkuja Euroopa päeva kontserdi ja festivaliala korraldamiseks 9. mail 2027 Narva Raekoja platsil. Hankijaks on Euroopa Komisjoni Eesti esindus (edaspidi Tellija). Mais 2027 tähistatakse Eestis taas Euroopa päeva avalike üritustega Tallinnas ja Narvas, rõhutades 9. maid kui rahu ja ühtsuse päeva Euroopas. Eelmiste aastate õnnestunud kogemusele tuginedes pakub Euroopa päeva programm erinevatele sihtrühmadele suunatud kaasavaid tegevusi ning võimalusi tutvuda Euroopa riikide ja kultuuridega. Ülevaate varasemate aastate Euroopa päeva üritustest leiab veebilehelt www.euroopapäev.ee. Euroopa Komisjoni Eesti esindus soovib hankida täisteenust Euroopa päeva suurejooneliseks tähistamiseks Narvas, mis hõlmab meelelahutusliku ja hariva ürituse terviklikku korraldamist. Hange näeb ette Euroopa päeva kontserdiprogrammi loomist, ettevalmistusi ja tehnilist teostust, sh ERR otseülekande tehnilise teostuse toetamist, festivaliala ülesehitust ning tehnilist tuge võimalike kõrvalürituste korraldamiseks nii Euroopa päeva ettevalmistusperioodi ajal kui ka Euroopa nädala jooksul. Lepingu maht ja maksumus Pakkumismenetluse alusel tehtavate tegevuste maksimaalne kogumaksumus on 115 000 (sada viisteist tuhat) eurot. Hind ei sisalda käibemaksu. Lepingu kestus Pakkumismenetluse tulemusena sõlmitud leping sõlmitakse kuni 7 kuuks vahemikus 30.11.2026 kuni 1.juuni 2027. Hanke väljakuulutamine: oktoober 2026 F&T Portal ja eSubmission Lepingu sõlmimise tähtaeg: 31.12.2026.

description:
The overall objective is to prepare candidate countries for implementing cohesion policy in the lead up to and upon accession. 
The specific objectives are:
1) to train staff from administrations at central and local/regional level participating in Interreg programmes (and IPA III programmes, if staff overlaps) and responsible for accession negotiations to reinforce their capacities for participating in and later on implementing cohesion policy programmes 
2) to organise thematic peer exchanges and technical clinics to reinforce and apply the knowledge gained during the training sessions, by allowing direct interaction with experienced Member State administrations and promote transfer of concrete practices 

In order to build up on activities already delivered and paradigm shifts initiated, these activities will be closely coordinated with other capacity building initiatives as well as other bilateral support measures the candidate countries currently benefit from IPA country programmes as well as Interact, TAIEX and Twinning, or other relevant activities.

description: Le Parlement européen lance régulièrement des procédures de passation de marchés publics en vue d’obtenir l’assistance juridique d’un cabinet d’avocats exerçant dans une juridiction spécifique et dans un domaine spécifique du droit. Ces procédures sont régies par les dispositions du règlement (UE, Euratom) 2024/2509 du Parlement européen et du Conseil du 23 septembre 2024 relatif aux règles financières applicables au budget général de l’Union (ci-après: le «RF»). Afin d’identifier les cabinets d’avocats présents sur le marché susceptibles d’être intéressés par la représentation du Parlement européen devant les tribunaux luxembourgeois et la fourniture d’une assistance juridique dans les affaires non contentieuses relevant du droit luxembourgeois, le service juridique du Parlement européen lance un appel à manifestation d’intérêt conformément aux dispositions du point 13.1 b) de l’annexe I du règlement financier.

description: The aim of this contract is to contribute to the data collection campaign for a project that investigates the role of private market actors, more specifically agro-dealers and agroecological service providers (ASPs), in strengthening the agroecological transition among smallholder farmers in West Kenya. The project will build on the private market engagement under the EU-funded KCEP-CRAL/BOOST project as a case-study. The data collection will target different types of actors, including agro-dealers, ASPs, farmers and other KCEP-CRAL/BOOST-project stakeholders, and involve different types of data collection instruments, including structured surveys, a mystery shopping exercise, in-depts and semi-structured interviews. The contractor will be responsible for designing and implementing a data collection campaign, selection, training and supervision of enumerators for the survey, and delivering cleaned survey and interview data. This contract is necessary to support the project’s objectives and requires specialized expertise and services to collect both quantitative and qualitative data among different types of actors and to effectively manage and coordinate the data collection campaign, ultimately contributing to the Commission’s goal of promoting sustainable agriculture and food systems in Africa, as well as supporting the Global Gateway agenda for investments in agrifood supply chains.

description: The overall objective of the project is to make Türkiye more equipped for climate change mitigation. The Contractor is expected to conduct the following activities: By taking into consideration the recent developments regarding the global stocktake (GST) under the Paris Agreement negotiations, this project will be linked with the global stocktake process under Paris Agreement. The Plan of National Stocktake System (NSS) will be created via need assessment, the gap analysis, sector analysis; sectoral technical dialogues; attending the international meetings for climate negotiations; conducting study visits on the models of stocktake systems; preparing the synthesis report of each sectoral technical dialogue. A national model of stocktake system will be designed; sectoral input collection guidelines will be prepared; trainings will be conducted on sectoral input collection methodologies for targeted institutions; National institutional capacity will be increased to implement National Stocktake System; trainings will be conducted on the issue of process of NSS and the communication strategy of NSS will be prepared.

In order to comply with these requirements, ECDC seeks a contractor who is able to ensure the medical service for the ECDC staff. The contractor has to be able to offer the services of a medical centre as required for pre-employment and annual medical tests and examinations as well as provide services on occupational health issues a The staff members working at the ECDC represents all EU nationalities. The number of staff entitled to medical services is approximately 350 (around 60% of women and 40% of men). The successful contractor is requested to carry out the tasks of a medical centre in charge of pre-employment and annual medical check-ups and provide the range of general, preventive and occupational medical services.

description:
This call for tender aims to monitor the performance of films recently supported under the MEDIA scheme Films on the Move – their availability, media presence and consumption. 
The requested service consists of two main deliverables:
1) provide online access to the required data in a reader-friendly way (summary by group of titles and/or by individual title), by customizing the database that the service provider owns
2) draft an analytical report based on the quantitative data, including a qualitative analysis on the differences in performance between the titles supported by Films on the Move and non-supported films and releases.
The subject of analysis is Creative Europe: MEDIA call Films on the Move, where distributors benefit from grants to run a larger-than-usual  promotion campaign, coordinated across all participating territories to reap benefits of scale, for certain non-national European titles. The purpose of Films on the Move is to increase the audiences to European non-national films thanks to the high quality of the films but also intensive promotion. DG CNECT, which is in charge of the Creative Europe MEDIA Programme, wants to assess the effects of Films on the Move by analysing the data on consumption of the films supported. 
Regarding the (1) customization of the database, the database should include the following categories for analysis: 
-	The data should be provided for 4 categories of films:
o	The titles which received Films on the Move support (around 45 – their choice will be agreed between CNECT and contractor at the start of the contract)
o	The market average for all films released in cinemas in MEDIA countries in the given time frame 
o	The average result of a non-nationally-released film (majority co-) produced in one of countries participating in Creative Europe: MEDIA
o	The average result of a group of selected 10-20 films which are comparable to the titles supported by Films on the Move (similar number of appearances in festivals, nominations and awards). The 10-20 comparable films will be chosen together by the Contractor and DG CNECT at the start of the contract.
-	The performance data on the 4 categories of the films above should be provided preferably broken down for 4 types of geographic regions:
o	The country where it was (majority co-) produced
o	in each country where its distribution is supported by the grant
o	in the rest of the MEDIA-participating countries
o	in the rest of the world (all non-MEDIA participating countries where data is available) – with data also singled out for all available countries, especially US and UK.
-	The data should be provided for the following 3 exploitation windows:
o	Cinemas
	tickets sold in cinemas in general (and in Europa Cinemas in particular)
	number of screenings (and in Europa Cinemas in particular)
	whenever possible, length of regular cinema run (and in Europa Cinemas in particular)
o	TVOD including online services of broadcasters 
	Number of platforms where the title is available, split by local and international platforms
	Whenever possible, length of availability on TVOD platforms, split by local and international platforms
	Wherever possible, number of TVOD purchases, split by local and international platforms
o	SVOD including online services of broadcasters 
	Number of platforms where the title is available, split by local and international platforms
	Whenever possible, Length of availability on SVOD platforms, split by local and international platforms
	Wherever applicable/possible, number of views, split by local and international platforms
-	Additionally, other indicators of performance are welcome. These might be in particular indicators of the film’s popularity and quality assessment (ratings), but other indicators are possible.

description: Frontex intends to launch a NP 3 procurement procedure for the provision of specialized consultancy services to support the implementation of firearms shooting instructors training activities. The objective of the assignment is to provide expert support in planning and conducting firearms instructors course, designing course requirements and drills to design firearms instructors firearms handling and content delivery abilities, contributing to the further development of the course curriculum. The consultant will also be expected to deliver a high-level master class for advanced instructors and prepare final reports and recommendations for the Activity Manager. The services are expected to be implemented over several short missions, including preparation and reporting. The forthcoming tender will be open to qualified individual experts or organizations with proven experience in: • High level firearms training delivery • Firearms training design (including developing training concepts and training manuals). • Firearms instructor development and adult learning methodologies. • Development of personal development plans.

In order to identify law firms on the market that may be interested in representing the European Parliament before Swedish courts and providing legal assistance in non-contentious cases under Swedish law, the Legal Service of the European Parliament is launching a call for expressions of interest in accordance with point 13.1(b) of Annex I to the FR.

description: The Representation requires the services of a journalist to author, review and revise the texts published on the website of the European Commission Representation in Ireland: https://ireland.representation.ec.europa.eu The total number of articles to be provided is 12 per calendar year and the average word length is 1200 words. These twelve texts will include the following: - updating for some of the pages under the Key EU policies for Ireland section - updating the page covering the Impact of EU membership on Ireland - authoring original pieces of content to be agreed with the Representation. The precise schedule/list of pages to be updated is to be agreed with the European Commission Representation in Ireland.

description: The project objective is construction of a central waste management facility(CWMF) and 6 transfer stations for establishing integrated self-sustainable waste management system for Northeast and East Regions in North Macedonia. The CWMF shall consist of sanitary landfill, sorting plant, Mechanical Biological Treatment, composting plant and green point in Sveti Nikole. The 6 Transfer stations will be located in Municipalities of Berovo,Makedonska Kamenica, Vinica, Stip, Rankovce and Kumanovo.

description: The European Parliament regularly launches public procurement procedures with a view to obtaining legal assistance from a law firm practicing in a specific jurisdiction and in a specific area of law. These procedures are governed by the provisions of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 September 2024 on the financial rules applicable to the general budget of the Union (hereinafter: the ‘FR’). In order to identify law firms on the market that may be interested in representing the European Parliament before Hungarian courts and providing legal assistance in non-contentious cases under Hungarian law, the Legal Service of the European Parliament is launching a call for expressions of interest in accordance with point 13.1(b) of Annex I to the FR.

description: EUAA currently has in place a framework contract for the Supply of coffee, coffee machines and related services for EUAA in Cyprus (FWC/EASO/2021/928). The current contract expires on the 17th of February2026. Therefore, a new framework contract needs to be put in place to provide coffee machines for the EUAA in Cyprus to allow continuity of services. EUAA might also request coffee machines to be placed at additional premises, within Cyprus, whether rented or owned by the EUAA or where EUAA staff are assigned or deployed. The overall objective of this framework contract is to provide coffee including coffee machines, ancillary services, for the consumption of beverages by EUAA staff members and visitors, including a professional service for installation and maintenance. The coffee machines will need to be of the type that can be adjusted to accommodate no-charge-required vending purposes and of the bean-to-cup type.

description: See konkursikutse hõlmab sotsiaalmeedia spetsialisti teenuseid eesti ja vene keeles. Euroopa Komisjoni Eesti esinduse kommunikatsiooniosakonna juhendamisel suhtleb teenuseosutaja (sotsiaalmeedia spetsialist) venekeelse kogukonnaga Eestis, aitab jagada ELi teemalist infot, jälgib venekeelset meediat ning korraldab üritusi ja kohtumisi, et tugevdada suhteid venekeelses kogukonnas. Sotsiaalmeedia spetsialist haldab esinduse sotsiaalmeedia kanaleid, suhtleb jälgijatega, vastab nende küsimustele ja sõnumitele eesti ja vene keeles, jälgib meie kanalites esilekerkivaid suundumusi või ohte, meie veebipubliku suhtumist eri teemadesse ja esitab selle kohta ülevaateid ning annab soovitusi, kuidas sisu inimeste paremaks kaasamiseks optimeerida.

description: The Security Directorate (DS) ensures the security of European Commission staff, premises and information. It carries out a variety of protective tasks, which include safeguarding the Institution's staff, premises and information against hostile intelligence services. Unit DS.2 is responsible for gathering, assessing, and disseminating information concerning threats related to the security of the Commission. It also carries out security investigations in the fields of espionage, terrorism and in cases of leaks of classified or sensitive information. In the context of the latter, it requires the adequate equipment to fulfil the duty. The aim of the contract resulting from this call for tender is to acquire thermal cameras for electronic countermeasures inspections.

description: Le programme Appui à la transition énergétique au Bénin est un programme d’appui budgétaire sectoriel au profit du Gouvernement de la République du Bénin. L’objectif principal de ce programme est d’accélérer la transition énergétique au Bénin, y compris la réduction des gaz à effet de serre (GES) prévus par la Contribution déterminée au niveau national (CDN). L’appui complémentaire à ce programme prévoit un marché de services d’assistance technique d’accompagnement afin de réaliser les objectifs spécifiques à savoir : • Appuyer la mise en œuvre de la réforme sectorielle, l’opérationnalisation des dispositions réglementaires et la gouvernance sectorielle en faveur de l’accès égal à une énergie efficace, durable, • Augmenter la participation du secteur privé dans le financement des investissements pour l’accès égal à l’énergie efficace, durable et moderne, la promotion de l’efficacité énergétique et de la création d’emplois, en particulier pour les jeunes et les femmes. • Augmenter l’accès égal de toute la population à l’électricité, particulièrement à partir de sources renouvelables et des solutions techniques améliorées et inclusives. • Augmenter l’efficacité énergétique tout au long du cycle de l’énergie (production, transport, distribution et consommation). Le secteur de l’énergie est au centre de cette assistance technique qui devra faciliter la mise en œuvre du programme à travers l’appui aux différents acteurs pour la réalisation de ces objectives, d’augmenter les capacités pour la mise en œuvre des politiques de réforme, d’assurer que l'évaluation et suivi des performances des politiques sectorielles sont améliorés et le dialogue politique est accompagné.

description: Le présent contrat d’études vise le dédoublement de la route Allada-Bohicon (76 km), avec aménagement des contre-allées ainsi que les aménagements spécifiques. Elles devront permettre de déterminer, de concevoir et de quantifier la nature des interventions à appliquer. Elles permettront la constitution des dossiers d’appels d’offres relatifs aux travaux permettant la sélection des entreprises capables de les exécuter, sur la base des conclusions des études techniques et en respectant les recommandations de l’étude environnementale.

description: This project is expected to assist strengthening capacities of relevant youth policy actors for the implementation of Youth Guarantee (YG) in Republic of Serbia. Project is focused on creating a sustainable, youth-centred ecosystem that supports youth engagement and employment through stronger policies, professionalization of youth work, and quality youth spaces. Furthermore, by building capacities, setting standards, and facilitating partnerships, the project will also ensure that youth in Republic of Serbia have access to relevant services and opportunities for active participation in labour market and in society. The objective of the project is also to enhance capacities of national, provincial and local youth policy actors to implement, monitor and report on youth employment policy and other policies relevant to youth.

description: The objective of this contract is to advance the implementation of Albania’s Digital Agenda in selected sectors by improving ICT infrastructure and aligning electronic communications policies with national and EU objectives. It will support the Albanian institutions, in particular the relevant Ministry and AKEP (hereinafter the beneficiaries) to increase their capabilities to promote trust in the global digital ecosystem by advancing inclusive and affordable connectivity so that all citizens can benefit from the digital economy and the future of Internet. In more details it will help prepare the documentations for conducting geographical survey and the methodology on very high capacity networks in the implementation of article 43 of the law no 54/2024 on electronic communication law in Albania in conformity with article 22 of EECC Directive and EU practice and drafting secondary legislation aligned with the EU regulation 2024/1309 for GIA, based on Very High-Capacity Networks (VHCN) with fibre optic and 5G. It will also perform the technical study for 5G use cases in smart communities based on EU best practices, design and implementation of a pilot project with 5G and awareness on gigabit infrastructure and 5G for relevant stakeholders.

description:
The objective of this contract is to advance the implementation of Albania’s Digital Agenda in selected sectors by improving ICT infrastructure and aligning electronic communications policies with national and EU objectives. 

It will support the Albanian institutions, in particular the relevant Ministry and AKEP (hereinafter the beneficiaries) to increase their capabilities to promote trust in the global digital ecosystem by advancing inclusive and affordable connectivity so that all citizens can benefit from the digital economy and the future of Internet.  

In more details it will help prepare the documentations for conducting geographical survey and the methodology on very high capacity networks in the implementation of article 43 of the law no 54/2024 on electronic communication law in Albania in conformity with article 22 of EECC Directive and EU practice and drafting secondary legislation aligned with the EU regulation 2024/1309 for GIA, based on Very High-Capacity Networks (VHCN) with fibre optic and 5G. 

It will also perform the technical study for 5G use cases in smart communities based on EU best practices, design and implementation of a pilot project with 5G and awareness on gigabit infrastructure and 5G for relevant stakeholders.

description: The general objective of this procurement is to provide high-quality survey fieldwork services enabling the JRC to collect behavioural evidence on how alternative regulatory approaches affect AI adoption decisions among firms in the European Union, with specific attention to rural-urban heterogeneity. The specific objectives are: 1. to programme and implement a survey questionnaire developed by the JRC, including embedded randomised experimental treatments; 2. to recruit and survey a representative sample of senior decision-makers in firms across at least three EU Member States; 3. to ensure sufficient representation of rural firms to permit rigorous subgroup analysis; 4. to deliver clean, anonymised, well-documented datasets suitable for advanced statistical analysis by the JRC; 5. to implement all fieldwork in accordance with EU data protection legislation and professional standards for survey research.
